2023-s-0024.summaryJa: クイアホーガ郡司法センターのドアを通り抜け,裁判官によって裁判を受けるために毎年何千人もの人々が歩きます. 彼らの多くは黒人であり,その多くは以前にもそこにいた. クリブランドコミュニティは,逮捕や請求決定,保釈へのアクセス,訴訟交渉,判決を含むシステム的な不公平がどのように積み重なっているのかを理解しようと目をつかまっています. <unk>Testify,<unk> The Marshall Projectは歴史的に不透明な Cuyahoga郡司法システムにおける正義の内部の仕組みを明らかにしています
2023-s-0024.impactJa: 多くの場所と同様にクリブランドのフェロニ・コート・データも完全にオープンです文書で誰でも調べることができるのです裁判所が収集したデータを公開することを拒否しているため非常に透明性がないのです The Marshall Projectは 70,000の裁判所記録とカウントを収集するためにスクレーパーを建設しデータを自分の物語のために保管する代わりにジャーナリストは住民やコミュニティメンバーが回答する質問をできるツールを作り出しました仮想コミュニティオフィス時間イベントを開催しクリブランド人との連絡を取りました裁判所に関するデータ質問に対する回答に関する我々の即興ツールについて感想をいただきましたクリブランドドキュメンタリー担当のSeanna Deneeはストリートでの理論を証明するデータを提供したいと願った私たちの現場での関与報告とクリブランドドキュメンタリーと連携 (Signal Clevelandという新しい出版物の一部になる間) はコミュニティへの信頼を築き多くのプラットフォームで裁判所システムや裁判官に関するコミュニティの質問や懸念を反映しましたマーシャルプロジェクトでは,コミュニティに投票パターンに関する一例目の分析を提供し,白人ばかりの郊外の投票者が,主に黒人クリーブランド住民の事件を司る裁判官を選びていたという事実を強調した.この分析は,アクセス可能な,一ページのビジュアル説明書でも共有され,コミュニティの会話が起こした. ウェンディ (DrIbram/status/1486822436653969416) はツイートした. <unk>This is the power of journalism.<unk> We republished the work with a slate of local partners <unk> Cleveland Documenters, WOVU, Real Deal Press, The Cleveland Observer (digital and print), The Cleveland Scene (digital and print), The Land, and Ideastream <unk> to ensure broad local distribution, and to support Cleveland-based media. 私たちはまた [このページ]を作成しました [https://www.themarshallproject.org/2022/01/27/reprint-testify) 作業を再印刷するプロセスを可能な限り簡単にするため,そして私たちの視覚説明書をスペイン語に翻訳しました.

2023-s-0025.summary: More than 1,800 people who served in the U.S. Congress in the 18th, 19th and even 20th centuries owned human beings at some point in their lives, according to a Washington Post investigation. The Washington Post has compiled [the first database of slaveholding members of Congress](https://www.washingtonpost.com/history/interactive/2022/congress-slaveowners-names-list/) by examining thousands of pages of census records and historical documents.
2023-s-0025.impact: [The Post’s list of enslavers in Congress investigation](https://www.washingtonpost.com/history/interactive/2022/congress-slaveowners-names-list/) is the first of its kind. In the process. This project uncoveres facts that alter the way many historical figures have been depicted. The Post’s work clarifies the record on many men whose relationship to slavery was previously hidden to the public, like Sen. Rufus King, who signed the Constitution and ran for president. Someone who walked past the plaque honoring him in New York City might have searched for him online and found the Wikipedia article extolling his anti-slavery activism. Before The Post’s project, they would not have found any mention of the fact that he once enslaved someone, too. The Biographical Directory of the U.S. Congress, which is the country’s official source of information on every person who has ever served in Congress, makes almost no mention of slavery. The Post’s journalism provides a much-needed comprehensive reference. This story has been strengthened by a unique level of reader involvement. Upon publication of the initial database and analysis, The Post asked readers to help research other possible slaveholders in Congress, eliciting hundreds of responses. Readers sent in remarkable documents: an enslaved grandmother’s oral history, a great-great-grandfather’s letter from a Civil War battlefield, newspaper clips showing congressmen seeking the return of escaped enslaved people and handwritten birth certificates showing babies born enslaved.

2023-s-0025.summaryJa: 18世紀,19世紀,そして20世紀にもわたって米国議会で務めた1800人以上の人々が,ワシントンポストの調査によると,人生のある時点で人間を所有していた.ワシントンポストは,人口普查記録と歴史的文書の数千ページを調査することによって, [議会の奴隷保有者の最初のデータベース]をまとめました.
2023-s-0025.impactJa: [議会調査における奴隷のリスト]https://www.washingtonpost.com/history/interactive/2022/congress-slaveowners-names-list/) は,その種の最初のものです.このプロセスでは.このプロジェクトは,多くの歴史的人物が描かれることを変化させる事実を明らかにします.ポストの仕事は,憲法に署名し大統領選に候補したルーフス・キング上院議員のような奴隷との関係が以前から一般に隠されていた多くの男性の記録を明らかにします. ニューヨーク市で彼を名誉に掲げる碑を横たわした人が,オンラインで彼を検索し,彼の奴隷制に反対する活動性を称賛するウィキペディア記事を見つけたかもしれない.ポストのプロジェクト以前,彼はかつて誰かを奴隷にしたという事実に関する言及は見つからなかっただろう.国会議員に勤務したすべての人の公式情報源である米国議会の伝記ディレクトリでは,奴隷制についてほとんど言及していない. ポストのジャーナリズムは,非常に必要とされる包括的な参照を提供します.この記事は,読者の参加のユニークなレベルによって強化されています.最初のデータベースと分析を公表すると,ポストは読者に議会で他の潜在的な奴隷所有者を研究するのを助けることを要求し,数百の回答を誘発しました. 奴隷の祖母の口頭話祖父の手紙市民戦争戦場からの手紙議会議員が逃亡した奴隷の帰還を求めた新聞のクリップ奴隷に生まれた赤ちゃんを示す手書きの出生証明書

2023-s-0026.summary: O Mapa dos Conflitos é um projeto da Agência Pública de Jornalismo Investigativo em parceria com a Comissão Pastoral da Terra (CPT) que, por meio de análise de dados, investiga ocorrências de conflitos no campo na Amazônia Legal na última década (2011-2020). Neste especial, foram analisados os conflitos no campo em comparação aos dados públicos relacionados a outras temáticas socioambientais como desmatamento, queimadas, mineração, água, agrotóxicos, violência e desigualdade. O projeto faz parte do especial “Amazônia sem lei”, que investiga a violência relacionada à regularização fundiária, à demarcação de terras e à reforma agrária na Amazônia Legal e no Cerrado.
2023-s-0026.impact: O Mapa dos Conflitos busca estimular o interesse dos leitores pelos conflitos no campo brasileiro por meio de uma visualização de dados intuitiva, interativa e com um visual que remete a um jogo de videogame. Mais do que isso, a plataforma também fornece uma base valiosa para jornalistas e pesquisadores produzirem suas reportagens, artigos e análises. Por esse motivo, publicamos o projeto em português, espanhol e inglês. O mapa é também uma ferramenta que pode ser trabalhada em sala de aula por professores. Esse projeto realizou a missão de reunir e visibilizar os dados fruto do importante trabalho da Comissão Pastoral da Terra, única entidade a realizar tão ampla pesquisa sobre os conflitos no campo em âmbito nacional. Não fosse a CPT, não saberíamos quem sofre injustiças fundiárias e, principalmente, não saberíamos quem morre no campo no Brasil — sobretudo na Amazônia. O Mapa dos Conflitos venceu o prêmio Design for a Better World 2022 na categoria Design Gráfico, Design Digital, UX, UI e Comunicação, conquistou o segundo lugar no Prêmio Direitos Humanos de Jornalismo 2022 e foi finalista no Prêmio Claudio Weber Abramo de Jornalismo de Dados na categoria Visualização. O projeto também apareceu no Top 10 de reportagens de jornalismo de dados mais populares no Twitter em uma seleção do Global Investigative Journalism Network (GIJN). O Mapa foi repercutido por sites de jornalismo nacional e internacional, como Portal Imprensa, Mídia Ninja, Associação Brasileira de Jornalismo Investigativo, LatAm Journalim Review, do Knight for Journalism in the Americas, e IJNet. Foi ainda recomendado na newsletter Chez les indés do site de notícias francês Basta! e na newsletter do Bellingcat, veículo de jornalismo investigativo com sede na Holanda.

2023-s-0026.summaryJa: 紛争地図は,土地牧草委員会 (CPT) と提携した調査ジャーナリズム公庁のプロジェクトで,データ分析を通じて,過去10年 (2011-2020) 法律アマゾンにおける紛争発生を調査しています.この特別で,森林伐採,燃焼,鉱山,水,農薬,暴力,不平等などの社会環境に関する他の社会環境問題に関する公共データと比較して,紛争現場を分析しました. このプロジェクトは,土地規制,土地の区分,および法定およびセラードの土地改革に関する暴力を調査する"法律のないアマゾン"の一部です.
2023-s-0026.impactJa: 紛争地図は,視覚的なビデオゲームのような視覚的なインタラクティブなデータ表示を通じて,ブラジルでの紛争に対する読者の興味を刺激することを目指しています. さらに,プラットフォームはジャーナリストや研究者たちが彼らの報道,記事,分析を制作するための貴重な基盤を提供します. この地図は教師が教室で作業できるツールでもありますこのプロジェクトでは,土地牧草委員会 (Earth Pastoral Commission) の重要な作業の結果を集め,データを公開するという使命が果たされました. この組織だけが,国内で田舎紛争に関する研究を広く行う唯一の機関です. CPTがなければ,土地不公平に苦しむ人,特にブラジルで,特にアマゾニアで田舎で誰が死ぬか,誰も知りません. 紛争地図はグラフィックデザイン,デジタルデザイン,UX,UI,コミュニケーション部門で Design for a Better World 2022賞を受賞し,ジャーナリズム人権賞2022で2位を獲得し,ビジュアル部門でデータジャーナリズムクラウディオ・ウェバー・ブラーム賞に最終名となった.プロジェクトは,Global Investigative Journalism Network (GIJN) の選択でTwitter上で最も人気のあるデータジャーナリズム報道トップ10に登場した. マップは,プロダクト・イン・ブラジリア・アソシエーション・オブ・インテグティブ・ジャーナリズム,ラット・アム・ジャーナリン・レビュー,ナイト・フォー・ジャーナリズム・イン・アメリカ,およびIJNetなどの国内・国際のジャーナリズムサイトによって評価されている.また,フランスニュースサイト『 Basta! のニュースレター Chez les indés』とオランダを拠点とする調査ジャーナリズム・車両であるベルングキャットのニュースレターでも推奨されている.

2023-s-0027.summary: g1 generated and published 11136 customized texts and videos with Brazilian two rounds election results hours after the votings in October 2022. Each had the results for a specific city, including votes and percentages for the President, Governor, and other elected officials. Delivering fast and detailed information for voters was crucial to counter coordinated attacks on the voting systems and false claims of election fraud that had been spreading before the ballot. It was the first time a news outlet released this number of automated election videos in such a short time. The content reached millions of people.
2023-s-0027.impact: The fast release of 5568 automated texts and videos with results of each Brazilian election round in October 2022 played a significant role in g1/globo effort to inform voters during the fiercest presidential election in the country's history. At that time the fear of massive countrywide protests to overturn the elections was real, and the quick and efficient way the press and Electoral Justice inform the public about the results are tought to have played a key role in preventing demonstrations to scale. g1/globo managed to deliver text and video with specific data for each Brazilian city, making the results more accessible and easy to search. One of the goals in automating content was to reach very small towns that compose two-thirds of Brazilian cities and are not used to get customized content from the press. The strategy of releasing automated content with citywide results was proven right when false messages started to spread showing fake presidential vote counts for Bolsonaro or Lula in specific cities. They could be easily disproven by the automated texts and videos. Millions of people viewed the automated texts and videos with Brazilian election results.

2023-s-0027.summaryJa: g1は2022年10月に投票後数時間,それぞれ特定の都市のための結果を生成し,大統領,知事,および他の選挙官のための投票と割合を含む. 投票システムへの調整された攻撃と選挙詐欺の偽の主張を counteractするために,投票者向けに迅速かつ詳細な情報を提供することが決定的でした. ニュースメディアがこんな短時間で自動選挙ビデオを公開したのは初めてですコンテンツは何百万人もの人に届きました
2023-s-0027.impactJa: 2022年10月にブラジル各選挙ラウンドの結果を伴う5568件の自動テキストとビデオが迅速にリリースされ,この国の史上最も激しい大統領選挙中に投票者への情報提供の重要な役割を果たしました. 選挙を覆すための大規模な全国的な抗議の恐れは現実的で, 報道機関と選挙司法が迅速かつ効率的に結果を国民に知らせる方法は規模規模のデモを防ぐのに重要な役割を果たしたはずである. g1/globoは,ブラジル各都市に具体的なデータを持つテキストとビデオを配信し, 結果をよりアクセス可能で検索しやすくしました. 都市全体のコンテンツを自動化する戦略は,特定の都市でボルソナロやルラに対する偽の大統領選挙投票数を示し,偽のメッセージが広がり始めたときに証明された. ブラジル選挙結果と自動化されたテキストとビデオを視聴した人が数百万でした

2023-s-0028.summary: Bloomberg exposed how services such as Google Maps and Search deliver misleading abortion-related information and how abortion foes collect data on people seeking pregnancy help online. Google changed their practices in response.
2023-s-0028.impact: Bloomberg’s data journalism reporting on abortion information provided by Google Maps and Google Search drew lawmakers’ attention and changed the tech company’s policy. In August, Bloomberg published the story showing that in a quarter of abortion searches, Google Maps – the most widely used US navigation tool – led users to crisis pregnancy centers (CPCs), non-medical organizations that seek to persuade women not to get abortions. In 13 states where abortion was newly criminalized, at least half of the top search results were for CPCs. Ten days later, Google said it will clearly label facilities in the US that provide abortions in search results and in Google Maps. In September, Bloomberg published another story showing that Google didn’t do enough to clearly label when advertisers don’t offer medical services to terminate a pregnancy. In this joint analysis by Bloomberg and the nonprofit Center for Countering Digital Hate, we found that in many abortion-related searches, Google still doesn’t apply the labels for CPCs. That means Google is still collecting ad revenue from CPCs without disclosing that such places do not provide abortions or refer patients to clinics that do. In November, citing Bloomberg’s reporting, US Senators Mark Warner and Elissa Slotkin wrote to Google’s CEO to urge the end to deceptive advertising and misrepresentation in search results, and to ensure accurate information for those seeking abortion support.
2023-s-0028.tools: Google Sheets, Python, Node.js, Javascript Svelte
2023-s-0028.authors: Davey Alba, Jack Gillum, Cedric Sam Editors: Sarah Frier and Yue Qiu With assistance from: Christopher Cannon, Julia Love, Elizabeth L. T. Moore and Prarthana Prakash
2023-s-0028.summaryJa: ブルームバーグは,Google MapsやSearchなどのサービスが堕胎に関する誤った情報をどのように提供し,堕胎の敵がオンラインで妊娠支援を求める人々のデータをどのように収集するかを明らかにした.
2023-s-0028.impactJa: Google MapsとGoogle Searchが提供した堕胎情報に関するBloombergのデータジャーナリズムが立法者たちの注意を引いて,テクノロジー会社の政策を変えた.8月に,Bloombergは,堕胎検索の4分の1で,最も広く使用されている米国のナビゲーションツールであるGoogle Mapsが女性を堕胎しないように説得しようとする非医療機関である危機妊娠センター (CPC) に導いたという記事を発表した. 妊娠中絶が新たに犯罪化された13州では,少なくとも検索結果の半分がCPCだった.10日後,Googleは検索結果やGoogle地図で妊娠中絶を提供する施設を明確に標識すると述べた.9月に,ブルームバーグは別の記事を掲載し,Googleが広告主が妊娠中絶を目的とした医療サービスを提供していない場合を明確に標識する十分な措置を取っていないことを示した. ブルームバーグと非営利デジタル・ヘイト対策センターが共同で行ったこの分析では, Googleは多くの堕胎関連の検索で CPCのラベルをまだ適用していないことがわかりました. つまり,GoogleはCPCからの広告収入をまだ収集していますが,そのような場所では堕胎を提供したり,患者たちを診療所へ送ったりしていないことが明らかになっていません. 11月にブルームバーグの報道を引用し,米国上院議員マーク・ワーナーとエリッサ・スロットキン氏は GoogleのCEOに手紙を書いて,検索結果における欺瞞的な広告や誤った表現をやめ,堕胎支援を求める人々に正確な情報を提供するよう求めた.

2023-s-0029.summary: As UK temperatures soared to a record 40C in July 2022, the BBC analysed satellite data to reveal those living in deprived areas were more than twice as likely to be in places vulnerable to high heat levels. The data analysis provided the basis for a news story and an interactive map that helped put people directly into the story of last year’s summer heat wave. Satellite analytics company 4 Earth Intelligence (4EI), provided the data, which the BBC analysed.
2023-s-0029.impact: As well as being used widely across BBC News outlets, the story was featured on the Apple News daily spotlight. The Red Cross, plan to use the map as a tool to assist with future planning for heatwaves. It was also shared with the charity’s Community Resilience Team.
2023-s-0029.tools: QGIS, Json, R, RStudio, OpenStreetMap, Others, please state
2023-s-0029.authors: Rob England, Harriet Bradshaw, Libby Rogers, Jana Tauschinski, Deirdre Finnerty, Wesley Stephenson, Alexander Ivanov, Marcos Gurgel, Shilpa Saraf, Becky Rush
2023-s-0029.summaryJa: BBCは2022年7月にイギリス気温が記録的な40°Cに上昇したため,衛星データを分析し,貧困地域に住む人々が高温レベルに脆弱な場所にいる可能性が2倍以上を示した.データ分析は,ニュース記事とインタラクティブな地図の基礎となり,人々が去年の夏の熱波の物語に直接触れることができました.衛星分析会社4 Earth Intelligence (4EI),BBCが分析したデータを提供しました.
2023-s-0029.impactJa: BBCニュース・メディアに広く利用されるほか,このニュースはApple Newsの日刊スポットライトに掲載されました.赤十字は,この地図を熱波の将来の計画に役立つツールとして利用する予定です.また,慈善団体Community Resilience Teamと共有されました.

2023-s-0030.summary: Durante os quatro anos de governo de Jair Bolsonaro, uma equipe de mais de 20 profissionais do Aos Fatos se engajou em acompanhar diariamente o que ex-presidente do Brasil dizia. Com um time de repórteres, editores, programadores e líderes de inovação, a organização desenvolveu métodos e novas tecnologias para dar conta da empreitada. Desse modo, Aos Fatos analisou ininterruptamente discursos, entrevistas, lives, redes sociais, entre outras aparições públicas de Bolsonaro, para entender quais foram os principais alvos de sua batalha contra a verdade factual. O resultado foi um trabalho abrangente e meticuloso que mostra a ascensão do golpismo no Brasil.
2023-s-0030.impact: Um dos impactos mais notáveis da cobertura sobre todas as mentiras ditas por Bolsonaro foi o então candidato à Presidência Lula mencionar, durante o principal debate das eleições de 2022, ao vivo, que Bolsonaro havia mentido, até então, 6.498 vezes durante o seu mandato, atribuindo o dado ao Aos Fatos. Isso gerou repercussão sem precedentes: - O portal UOL repercutiu nas suas redes (TikTok, YouTube, Twitter) o registro de Lula (https://www.tiktok.com/@uol/video/7159763525135600902) alcançando cerca de 10 milhões de seguidores; - O debate gerou recorde de audiência, a maior em 16 anos, segundo o jornal Valor Econômico; - Jornais como Correio Braziliense e Diário de Pernambuco também repercutiram. Outro impacto substancial da cobertura foi ter subsidiado um pedido de abertura de inquérito que apura a participação de Bolsonaro na incitação aos atos que culminaram na invasão do Congresso Nacional, do Palácio do Planalto e do Supremo Tribunal Federal em 8 de janeiro de 2023. Esse documento, encaminhado em 12 de janeiro de 2023 ao procurador-geral da República, Augusto Aras, afirma que "Bolsonaro tem sugerido em diversas manifestações públicas, desde setembro de 2021" que as "instituições democráticas não são confiáveis". A informação foi retirada deste projeto. Esse pedido foi acatado e, hoje, o ex-presidente está sob investigação. A investigação também foi mencionada em veículos internacionais, como Poynter, Deustch Welle e Washington Post. O que é mais notável na imprensa brasileira, no entanto, é que Aos Fatos criou uma cultura de acompanhamento sistemático das falas de Bolsonaro, tornando mais comum no noticiário do país análises críticas de declarações falsas ou enganosas dele e de demais políticos que se utilizam da mentira como arma política. O projeto também foi uma ferramenta útil para mapear o golpismo de Bolsonaro e produzir investigações que ajudam a explicar o contexto dos atos golpistas de 8 de janeiro: https://www.aosfatos.org/noticias/bolsonaro-mentiras-quatro-anos-de-golpismo/.
2023-s-0030.authors: Tai Nalon, Bernardo Moura, Luis Felipe dos Santos, Ana Freitas, Ana Rita Cunha, Amanda Ribeiro, Luiz Fernando Menezes, Bruno Fávero, Priscila Pacheco, Marco Faustino, Carolina Cavaleiro, Rômulo Collopy, Erico Rosa, Guilherme Lobo, Sérgio Spagnuolo, Bárbara Libório
2023-s-0030.summaryJa: ブラジル元大統領が語ったことを毎日追跡するために20人以上の専門家が活動した. ジャーナリスト,編集者,プログラマー,イノベーションリーダーの一団と共に,組織は事業を説明するための方法と新しい技術を開発した. Aos Fatosは,事実上の真実との戦いにおいて,ボルソナロの主要な標的を理解するために,彼の演説,インタビュー,ライブ,ソーシャルメディアなどを絶え間なく分析した.結果として,ブラジルのクーデターの上昇を示した包括的で細心の作業でした.
2023-s-0030.impactJa: ボルソナロが語った嘘の報道の最も顕著な影響の一つは,当時の大統領候補ルラが2022年の主要選挙の議論で, ボルソナロが大統領任期中に6,498回嘘をついて事実に負けたことを言及したことです. 議論は16年ぶりで視聴率記録を記録した. ブラジル郵便局やペルナムブコ日報などの新聞も視聴率を記録した. 報道のもう一つの大きな影響は,2023年1月8日に国民議会,プラナルト宮殿,連邦最高裁判所を侵略した行為の誘発にボルソナロの関与を訴える調査開始の要請を補助したことです. この文書は2023年1月12日に共和国検察総長アウグスト・アラスに送られた.この文書は"ボルソナロは2021年9月以降"民主主義機関が信頼できない"と様々な公的なデモで示唆している"と述べている.この文書はこのプロジェクトから取り上げられた.この要求は,受け入れられ,今日元大統領は調査を受けている.調査はポインター,デュストク・ウェル,ワシントン・ポストなどの国際機関でも言及されている. しかし,ブラジルメディアで最も顕著なのは,Aos Fatosがボルソナロの発言を体系的に追跡する文化を作り出し,ボルソナロや政治兵器として嘘を活用する他の政治家による虚偽または欺瞞的な発言の批判的な分析を国のニュースでよりよく取り上げていることです. プロジェクトはまた,ボルソナロのクーデターをマッピングし,1月8日のクーデター事件の背景を説明する調査を制作する有用なツールでした.

2023-s-0031.summary: The story outlined the looming threat of space debris in low-Earth orbit and the consequences of not addressing or mitigating the problem. We built the story as a 3D, scrolling explainer, constructing a number of scenes in orbit to explain important concepts that would be difficult to articulate through text or static charts alone. The project was produced in collaboration with Peggy Hollinger, International Business Editor at the FT, who has covered the commoditisation of space extensively. The reporting involved conversations with officials from ESA and NASA, as well as various other researchers, experts, and astronauts.
2023-s-0031.impact: The article was a hit with readers, with roughly a quarter reading the entire piece. The article was also published to coincide with the FT Investing In Space conference and used to frame discussions about how we can best mitigate against the growing issue of space debris. The piece was also widely shared on social media and repackaged into one of the FT’s best performing Instagram reels of the year. The combination of in-depth reporting and 3D visuals helped us take the FT’s reporting — and the complex world of space — to a younger audience.
2023-s-0031.tools: Animation, 3D modeling, Three.js, Canvas, Adobe Creative Suite, CSV, Python, Blender React Shapr3D
2023-s-0031.authors: Sam Learner, Peggy Hollinger, Sam Joiner, Caroline Nevitt, Ian Bott
2023-s-0031.summaryJa: この物語は,地球低軌道における宇宙の破片の脅威と,この問題を解決したり,緩和したりしない結果について説明しました.私たちは3Dで物語を構築し,スクロールする説明機として,文本や静態チャートだけで表現するのが難しい重要な概念を説明するために軌道上の多くのシーンを構築しました. このプロジェクトは,FTの国際ビジネス編集者,Peggy Hollingerと協力して制作された.このレポートは,宇宙の商品化について広範に報道した.このレポートには,ESAとNASAの関係者,および他のさまざまな研究者や専門家,宇宙飛行士との会話が含まれていた.
2023-s-0031.impactJa: この記事は読者達でヒットし,約4分の1が全文を読んだ.また, FT Investing In Space会議に合致して発表された.そして,宇宙廃棄物の増大する問題に対する最善の緩和策について議論を策定するために使用された.この記事はソーシャルメディアでも広く共有され,FTの年度最高のインスタグラムロールの一つに再編された. 詳細なレポートと3Dビジュアルの組み合わせは FT<unk>のレポートと複雑な宇宙の世界を若い観客に届けることができました

2023-s-0032.summary: In 2022, Ghana's economy almost crashed. This forced government of Ghana to engage the International Monetary Fund for a bailout. Ghanaians blamed Finance Minister Ken Ofori Atta for mismanaging the economy and clamoured for his dismissal. The tweets garnered from the #KenMustGo were largely organic. Over 9660 Twitter users used the hashtag. A counternarrative #KenMustStay emerged. 292 users of Twitter wanted the finance minister to stay. This project tracked #KenMustGo and #KenMustStay. #KenMustStay narrative was largely inorganic. The coordinated sharing of scripted messages exposed in this work showed how social media is used to paint a false narrative.
2023-s-0032.impact: This project exposed many sockpuppet twitter accounts that called for the Finance Minister to stay in office. After the investigation, the 292 tweet accounts were exposed and stopped the coordinated sharing of tweets under the #KenMustStay. The public became aware that #KenMustStay was a fake trend. The story generated widespread discussions.
2023-s-0032.summaryJa: ガーナ経済はほぼ崩壊した.このことで,ガーナ政府は国際通貨基金に救済策を要請するよう強制された.ガーナ人は財務大臣ケーン・オフォリ・アタを経済管理不良で非難し,解雇を求める叫びをかけた. #KenMustGoから得たツイートは主に有機的なものだった.9,660人以上のツイッターユーザーはハッシュタグを使用した.反面の #KenMustStayが出現した.ツイッターユーザーの292人は財務大臣を残すことを望んだ. このプロジェクトでは #KenMustGoと #KenMustStayを追跡した. #KenMustStayの物語は,主に非有機的なものだった.この作品で暴露された脚本メッセージの協調された共有は,ソーシャルメディアが偽りの物語を描くのにどのように利用されているかを示した.
2023-s-0032.impactJa: このプロジェクトは,財務大臣を職務に留守するよう求めた多くのソックパペットツイッターアカウントを暴露した.調査の後,292のツイッターアカウントが暴露され, #KenMustStayの下でツイートの協調された共有を停止した.公衆は #KenMustStayが偽のトレンドであることを認識した.この話は広範な議論を引き起こした.

2023-s-0033.summary: The investigation relies on analyzing wage bulletin data issued by the Egyptian Statistical Center, during the last five years, to prove the gap in wages between women and men in the public and private sectors in various professions, in violation of Egyptian law. The data showed that, the wage gap did not narrow, but rather increased. According to data analysis, this disparity is equivalent to a 28% difference in income between men and women in the public and private sectors. in light of the absence of any role from the workforce, and the Manpower Committee in the House of Representatives.
2023-s-0033.impact: When he spoke with the National Wages Council in Egypt, the official told me that this is the first time he has heard about this problem and that they have not discussed this issue before, so I am one of the first to talk about this issue in a data-driven investigation. I also spoke to the head of the Parliament’s Manpower Committee, Adel Abdel-Fadil, and they are now in the process of finalizing the new labor law, and he said that he had never heard of this problem and they did not discuss it in the House of Representatives, and after publishing the investigation, he told me that he would discuss this issue in the House of Representatives, and during the discussion of the law new work. She also sent the investigation to the head of the National Council for Women and officials in the workforce and civil society to discuss this topic in the new law.
2023-s-0033.tools: Scraping, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Python
2023-s-0033.summaryJa: 調査は,エジプト法に反して,エジプトの公共と民間部門の男女間の賃金格差を証明するために,エジプト統計センターが過去5年間発行した賃金公告データを分析した.データによると,賃金格差は狭いではなく増加した.データ分析によると,この差は,公と民間部門の男女間の所得格差の28%に相当する. 労働力,そして代表館の人力委員会からの役割の欠如の光において
2023-s-0033.impactJa: 彼はエジプトの国民賃金委員会と話をしたとき官僚は私に言いましたこの問題について初めて聞いたことであり彼らはこの問題を前に議論していないのでデータ主導の調査でこの問題について最初に話すのは私ですまた,議会の人力委員会長アデル・アブデル・ファディルと話をしました彼らは新しい労働法を最終的な形で作成しているのですが, 彼はこの問題について聞いたことがなく, 議会で議論していないと言いました. そして調査を公表した後,彼は議会でこの問題を議論すると, そして新しい法律の議論中に, また,彼女はこの調査を,新しい法律でこの話題を議論するために,労働力と市民社会における女性のための国家理事会の責任者にも送った.

2023-s-0034.summary: By investigating the Meta Pixel, we revealed that the largest pharmacy in Sweden, state-owned Apoteket AB, for several years shared personally identifiable data and information about over-the-counter pharmacy purchases of approximately one million online customers with Meta. We also exposed leaks by several other actors in the health sector. When we asked Meta what happened with the data, they responded, “[O]ur systems are designed to remove potentially sensitive data”. By creating our own virtual, fake online pharmacy and a robot customer, we showed that Meta in fact, and contrary to their claim, stored such information.
2023-s-0034.impact: As a direct consequence of the first part of our project, all actors mentioned in our stories reported their data breaches to the Swedish Data Protection Authority, removed or deactivated the Meta Pixel and initiated internal investigations. The Swedish Data Protection Authority opened formal investigations into three pharmacy chains and the online health care provider Kry/Livi, which had shared, for example, e-mail addresses of patients and doctors with Meta. Kry told us that their data breach had affected an estimated 90,000 users across several European countries. All of the authority's investigations may or may not lead to fines under the GDPR. We were also able to use the software we developed in the project to expose leaks from membership application forms of two political parties in Sweden. In the second part of our project, we showed that Meta – despite filters, their own data policies and claims to notify advertisers who send them sensitive data – in fact stored information about medications, diagnoses and illnesses sent from our fake pharmacy via the Meta Pixel, contradicting their statements made to us. Our investigation was the first to test the robustness of Meta’s filtering systems for health data, raising questions such as which languages they had trained it to work on and whether it worked in Swedish at all. “For sale: your health” was shortlisted for the 2022 edition of the Swedish Grand Prize for Journalism as Innovator of the Year.
2023-s-0034.tools: Scraping, Json, Microsoft Excel, Python, Vue.js
2023-s-0034.summaryJa: メタピクセルを調査することでスウェーデンの最大の薬局である州営薬局 ABが数年間メタとオンラインで約100万人のオンライン薬局購入に関する個人情報と情報を共有し医療業界で他の多くの企業が漏洩したことも明らかになりましたデータをどう処理したか尋ねると回答したのはシステムでは潜在的に敏感なデータを削除するように設計されています仮想の偽装のオンライン薬局とロボット顧客を作り上げることでメタが事実上,その主張に反してこのような情報を保存していたことを示しました
2023-s-0034.impactJa: プロジェクトの最初の部分の直接的な結果として,私たちの物語に言及されたすべての俳優はスウェーデンデータ保護局にデータ侵害を報告し,メタピクセルを削除または無効にし,内部調査を開始しました. スウェーデンデータ保護局は3つの薬局チェーンとオンライン医療提供者Kry/Liviに公式な調査を開始しました. クライはデータ侵害がヨーロッパ各国で 90,000人のユーザーに影響を及ぼしたと告げた. 当局の調査は GDPRの罰金に導かれないかもしれない. また,プロジェクトで開発したソフトウェアを使ってスウェーデンの2つの政党の会員申請書から漏洩を暴露することができました. プロジェクト第2部では Meta <unk> がフィルターやデータポリシーと広告主に対して情報を発信する主張にもかかわらず偽薬局から送られてきた薬や診断や病気に関する情報をメタピクセルで保存し偽薬局から送られてきたのです私たちの調査は Meta<unk>の健康データフィルタリングシステムの強さをテストし,どの言語で訓練されたのか,スウェーデン語で機能しているかといった疑問を提起しました <unk>For sale: your health<unk>は 2022年にスウェーデン大ジャーナリズム賞"イノベーション・オブ・ザ・イヤー"に候補となりました

2023-s-0035.summary: Data captured by South Africa’s national Water and Sanitation Department (DWS) show more than half of all municipal sewage treatment works fail to treat sewage to minimum standards before releasing it into rivers. Besides the ecological damage, this pollution flows into dams supplying drinking water to citizens. Further, data shows drinking water fails to meet minimum standards in two thirds of all municipalities responsible for potable water supply, and many fail to provide any water for days, sometimes weeks at a time. Through a series of stories, we exposed this systemic national failure and its devastating effects.
2023-s-0035.impact: "The project had a series of significant impacts. Our reporting on sewage pollution in Cape Town, which laid the foundation for this nationwide investigation, contributed to Cape Town's new mayor, who was elected on 1 November 2021, declaring sewage pollution a top priority during his campaign. He removed the previous political head of water and sanitation in the city, and spent his first day in office visiting particularly egregious sites of pollution. The city now makes the results of its inland and coastal water quality tests public. The nationwide Green Drop Report, which is a national regulatory audit of the country’s wastewater treatment, was resumed in 2021 after being halted in 2016. We believe these stories, and others which led up to these, may have had some influence. The project had widespread distribution, as many of the stories were republished by some of the most respected news outlets in Ghana, Malawi, South Africa, Nigeria, The Gambia, Mali, and the United States. It earned professional recognition, being named one of the best investigative projects in sub-Saharan Africa for 2022 by the [GIJN](https://gijn.org/2022/12/08/2022s-best-investigative-stories-from-sub-saharan-africa/). Teamembers were invited to talk about the research at universities, conferences and debates. This included a successful application to speak at the continent-wide African Investigative Journalism Conference (AIJC) in Johannesburg, SA and the University of Lorraine in Metz, France, among others. Finally, researchers, NGO’s, advocacy groups and other colleagues got inspired by our work and approached us for our methodology and data. Most notably, InfoNile, a non-profit cross-border group of data and geo journalists, contacted us to follow up on our investigation and methodology to cover the situation in the Nile River Basin."

2023-s-0035.summaryJa: 南アフリカ国家水衛生局 (DWS) が収集したデータによると,市内の排水処理事業の半数以上が,排水を川に放出する前に最低基準に処理していない.生態系被害に加えて,この汚染は市民に飲料水を供給するダムに流出する. さらに,データによると,飲料水供給の責任のある市政の3分の2では,飲料水が最低基準を満たしていないことが示され,多くの市政は数日間,時には数週間にわたって水を提供できていないことが示されています.
2023-s-0035.impactJa: "このプロジェクトは一連の重要な影響をもたらした.この全国の調査の基礎を設けたケープタウンにおける排水汚染に関する我々の報告は,2021年11月1日に選出されたケープタウン市長が,選挙運動中に排水汚染を最優先事項として宣言することに貢献した.彼は,町の水と衛生の以前の政治長官を退去し,最初の当日,特に恐ろしい汚染現場を訪れた. 都市は今,内陸および沿岸水質試験の結果を公開しています. 国内での廃棄水処理に関する国家規制監査であるグリーンドロップレポートは,2016年に停止した後,2021年に再開されました.これらの物語,およびこれらの結果をもたらした他の物語は,何らかの影響を与えた可能性があると考えています. このプロジェクトは,ガーナ,マラウィ,南アフリカ,ナイジェリア,ガンビア,マリ,米国で最も尊敬されるニュース機関によって再刊行され,多くの報道が広く配布された.このプロジェクトは, [GIJN]によって2022年のサハラ以南アフリカにおける最高の調査プロジェクトの一つに選ばれ,専門的な評価を得ました. チームメンバーは大学,会議,議論で研究について話し合うよう招待されました.この中には,アフリカ大陸規模の調査ジャーナリズム会議 (AIJC) に (SA) 講演する成功申し込みも含まれていました. 特に非営利のデータ・ジオジャーナリストグループである InfoNileは, ナイルの盆地での状況を調査し,その方法論を調査するために,連絡をくれました".

2023-s-0036.summary: More than 100 million people in America are saddled with medical bills they cannot pay. It was the first headline finding of KHN senior correspondent Noam N. Levey’s yearlong investigation into a staggering failure of U.S. health care: It systematically pushes patients into debt. KHN’s **Diagnosis: Debt** project pulled back the curtain on this crisis, the true scale of which had been obscured even from many policymakers and medical practitioners. The investigation – in digital, audio and broadcast stories – exposed what is now an epidemic of medical debt that is now a defining feature of the nation’s health care system.
2023-s-0036.impact: **Diagnosis: Debt** has catalyzed a growing national discussion about medical debt. KHN’s findings were cited prominently in a successful November ballot initiative in Arizona to expand patient protections. And federal regulators at the CFPB asked subjects from Levey’s story to provide public testimony about nursing homes suing friends and families of residents and then stepped up investigation of the industry’s debt collection practices. The stories prompted good Samaritans to come forward to help relieve the debts of people profiled by KHN, several of whom had their entire debt settled, KHN learned. In December, Aledade, a physician-led company that supports primary care providers, cited the project when it paid to help retire the debt of more than 85,000 patients in Louisiana and Mississippi. In the announcement, Aledade founder Dr. Farzad Mostashari called the series “a complete and utter indictment of the financial structures in our health care system.” The project found a large and engaged readership. As a public service, KHN provides all of its coverage to any news outlet to re-publish. And hundreds of media outlets picked up our **Diagnosis: Debt** stories. The stories frequently appeared in the “Top Stories” in Apple News. Our coordinated social media posts with NPR garnered hundreds of thousands of views and thousands of comments. Key stories were translated for Spanish and Chinese audiences. Levey’s findings informed an episode of Tradeoffs, a health care podcast. A callout to readers pulled in hundreds more heart-wrenching stories, which we expect to inform further reporting this year.

2023-s-0036.impactJa: **診断:借金は医療負債に関する全国的な議論を促した. NPRとの連携したソーシャル・メディア投稿は,何百万人ものビューと何千ものコメントを集めました.キーストーリーはスペイン語と中国語の視聴者向けに翻訳されました. レヴィーの発見は,健康ケアポッドキャストの Tradeoffsのエピソードを提示しました. 読者への呼びかけは,さらに数百人の心傷つくるストーリーを提示しました.

2023-s-0037.summary: Many public schools across the country fail to provide required support to homeless students, decreasing the odds of reaching graduation — and increasing the risk of long-term housing instability. Our analysis suggests that roughly 300,000 students are falling through the cracks of a system meant to help. As one district found, the right support makes a big difference in graduation rates. But federal funding for this work is so low that it doesn’t come close to covering the true cost.
2023-s-0037.impact: Our investigation, launched in November, had an immediate impact. U.S. Rep. Emanuel Cleaver of Missouri, who chairs the House subcommittee that oversees efforts on homelessness, [vowed to discuss undercounting with federal officials](https://publicintegrity.org/education/unhoused-and-undercounted/government-helping-homeless-students-mckinney-vento-funding/). Staff for U.S. Rep. Don Bacon of Nebraska contacted superintendents in his district for answers after Public Integrity’s analysis showed likely undercounts there. And in December, Congress increased funding for homeless-student support by 13%. A robust reporting collaboration also put information about the little-known and often-misunderstood requirements to serve homeless students in the hands of more people. The Center for Public Integrity partnered with The Seattle Times, Street Sense Media and WAMU/DCist, each newsroom producing stories that made use of Public Integrity’s data analysis. We also made the data and other resources available to additional newsrooms pre-publication, part of an innovative national-local collaboration that included a detailed reporting kit and Zoom office hours for reporting help. All told, nine newsrooms produced stories with the data. The pieces were published in November and December. The potential for more impact is high. Both in interviews and the later follow-up by staff for a member of Congress, some school officials responsible for serving homeless students showed confusion about who should be identified and helped. The federal definition includes children doubled-up with friends or extended family out of economic need after losing their home, for instance. Our stories laid out who qualifies and what’s required. The December funding increase is a start, but Congress could increase identification and improve support by putting more money toward the effort. Meanwhile, enforcement of the law is weak. The federal and state departments of education could use a benchmark like ours to flag districts likely undercounting and investigate further. Michigan has guidelines for that.

2023-s-0038.summary: Space debris poses a threat to both satellites and future space missions. The littering of space with defunct satellites and old rockets has accelerated dramatically these last years, mainly due to space launches from the private sector, above all Elon Musk’s Starlink project. Experts warn that soon a chain reaction could unfold, where fragments from collisions make parts of Earth’s orbit dangerous to use. With the help of interactive storytelling and an exclusive data analysis, our project shows how big the problem already is, while also describing what is at stake and what could be done to improve the situation.
2023-s-0038.impact: For the first time, we are making the entire extent of the space debris problem visible with this project. Comparable projects often only show actual satellites and not even the smallest pieces of space debris that have been created by collisions, for example. We therefore turned to the European Space Agency (ESA) and obtained the data set that ESA itself uses to produce its forecasts. It contains all space debris collisions of the past, as well as sophisticated simulations for the time evolution of the debris cloud.

2023-s-0039.summary: As global warming increases the frequency and intensity of heat waves, knowing where heat islands are in our cities — and who lives in them — becomes a crucial public health issue. We used satellite imagery to pinpoint the areas with the hottest land surface temperatures across 17 Canadian metropolitan areas. Then, we overlayed the temperatures with the Canadian census data, showing that immigrants and people with low income are most likely to live in the hottest urban areas. As one expert told us, "this is evidence that there is injustice in who will be more vulnerable to climate change."
2023-s-0039.impact: Altogether, this series garnered more than 700,000 page views. In ‘Here’s who lives in your city’s worst heat islands’, almost every reader typed in their postal code to get information about their neighbourhood. They also interacted with the chart arrows three times on average. User engagement was well above average for all pieces in the series. On top of the stories, we also published all of our analysis data and code, allowing anyone to review our work and reuse it. Shiab was contacted by the University of Calgary (Canada), McMaster University (Canada), Laval University (Canada), UQAM (Canada), the University of Waterloo (Canada), the Bureau of Investigative Journalism (UK), and Data journalisme Paris (France) to talk about the project.

2023-s-0040.summary: We dug into property records to uncover the scale and impact of the single-family rental industry in North Carolina. We found that, in the space of a decade, corporate landlords had gone from owning nearly zero houses in North Carolina to owning more than 40,000. In Charlotte, these companies own one out of every four rental homes, putting pressure on would-be homeowners and tenants alike. Our reporting revealed a business model designed to squeeze every drop of profit out of renters. And we demonstrated how both federal policy and state pension investments fueled the industry’s rise.
2023-s-0040.impact: Until our project, there had never been an accurate count – much less precise geospatial data – on corporate ownership of single-family housing in any U.S. state. Months of tedious data work allowed reporters to lift this veil of obscurity and answer critical questions for the first time, revealing stories about the single-family rental industry’s growth, its impact and the expanding number of people affected by it. David Szakonyi, an assistant professor at George Washington University and co-founder of the Anti-Corruption Data Collective who reviewed our findings, called the project the “best exercise I’ve ever seen trying to identify properties owned by large institutional investments.” Our reporting prompted swift reaction. A virtual town hall to answer reader questions attracted hundreds of live viewers. Raleigh’s mayor pro-tem [called for action](https://www.newsobserver.com/news/local/counties/wake-county/article261036377.html) from the city council. Mecklenburg County officials [pledged half a million dollars](https://www.charlotteobserver.com/news/local/article261634477.html) to study the problem and [pushed for federal action](https://www.charlotteobserver.com/news/local/article264692029.html). Rep. Alma Adams, D-N.C., [entered our investigation into the Congressional record](https://www.charlotteobserver.com/news/state/north-carolina/article261378217.html) and announced that she was authoring related legislation. A national watchdog group cited our work [in a call](https://www.newsobserver.com/news/state/north-carolina/article268767412.html) to end state pension fund investments in the largest corporate landlord’s major private equity backer. Because we published [our data and methodology](https://github.com/mcclatchy-southeast/security_for_sale), as well as [a toolkit for reporters](https://mcclatchy-southeast.github.io/sfr-toolkit/), newsrooms around the country could uncover the scale of corporate landlords in their backyards. Our work aided and inspired new and in-progress reporting in [California](https://www.sfchronicle.com/about/newsroomnews/article/Year-long-Chronicle-data-project-reveals-who-owns-17453051.php), [Kentucky](https://www.leoweekly.com/2022/08/a-corporate-landlords-takeover-spotlights-racial-inequities-and-displacement-fears-in-west-louisville/) and [New Jersey](https://www.app.com/in-depth/news/local/how-we-live/2022/08/25/nj-real-estate-housing-market-prices-investors-llc-newark-asbury-park/9793039002/); and Law360 used our toolkit [in a six-part series in Arizona](https://www.law360.com/articles/1541888?scroll=1&related=1). Our reporting also prompted researchers to further study the impact of corporate landlords. Two, from Princeton and the University of Pennsylvania, are studying the rise of institutional investors in rental housing, and they’re basing their research in Charlotte largely because of what we revealed there.

2023-s-0040.summaryJa: シャーロット州では 4 家の家の 1 家の家が持ちられているので,その企業は住宅オーナーと賃貸者に圧力を及ぼしています. 報告では賃貸者の利益の落とし穴を絞るビジネスモデルが明らかになりました連邦政策と州政府の年金投資が産業の成長に与える影響を示しました
2023-s-0040.impactJa: プロジェクトまで,米国各州で単一家庭住宅の企業所有に関する正確な統計はありませんでした. 退屈なデータ作業の数ヶ月間では,ジャーナリストが初めてこの暗い面膜を解除し,重要な質問に答えることができ,単一家庭賃貸業界の成長,影響と影響を受ける人々の増加に関する物語を明らかにしました. ジョージ・ワシントン大学の助教授で,我々の調査結果をレビューしたアンチ・腐敗データ・コレクティブの共同創設者であるデイヴィッド・サコニニーは,このプロジェクトを,大きな機関投資による物件を特定しようと試みた史上最高の運動と呼んだ. レイリー市長のプロテム [行動に呼びかけ] (https://www.newsobserver.com/news/local/counties/wake-county/article261036377.html) は市議会から. メックレンブルク郡の役人は [50万ドルを約束] (https://www.charlotteobserver.com/news/local/article261634477.html) 問題を研究し,連邦の行動に推し] (https://www.charlotteobserver.com/news/local/article264692029.html) 代表. アルマ・アダムズ (D-N.C.) は, [議会の記録への調査を入力しました]https://www.charlotteobserver.com/news/state/north-carolina/article261378217.html) そして,関連立法の執筆を発表した. 報道機関が全国の新聞室に企業家たちの規模を明らかにできるのです報道機関が報道機関に提供する情報も私たちの研究は [カリフォルニア州]https://www.sfchronicle.com/about/newsroomnews/article/Year-long-Chronicle-data-project-reveals-who-owns-17453051.php), [Kentucky] (https://www.leoweekly.com/2022/08/a-corporate-landlords-take-over-spotlights-racial-inequities-and-displacement-fears-in-west-louisville/) と [ニュージャージー] (https://www.app.com/in-depth/news/local/how-we-live/2022/08/25/nj-using-real-estate-ho-market-prices-llors-newark-newark) に関連した新しい報告を助長し,刺激しました. 報告はまた,企業家による影響をさらに研究するよう研究者に促した.プリンストン大学とペンシルベニア大学から2人が,賃貸住宅における機関投資家の増加を研究しており,彼らはその調査をシャーロットに基盤としている.

2023-s-0041.summary: O Mapa da Água revela os municípios onde empresas e órgãos de abastecimento identificaram substâncias químicas e radioativas em doses acima do limite na água que sai da torneira entre 2018 e 2020, a partir de dados do Ministério da Saúde. Ferramenta interativa, é possível clicar na ficha de cada município para saber detalhes sobre substâncias detectadas, além das principais classificações de risco sobre cada uma delas. A ferramenta destaca ainda um “alerta máximo” para os locais onde a mesma substância esteve acima da concentração máxima nos 3 anos analisados – segundo especialistas, os casos mais preocupantes são de contaminação contínua.
2023-s-0041.impact: O interesse público pode ser comprovado pela audiência, republicação e impacto. Foram mais de 400 mil visualizações únicas no mapa e suas matérias apenas no site da Repórter Brasil, além de mais de 600 republicações e reportagens sobre o mapa em sites, canais de TV e estações de rádio – em mais de 20 casos, a reportagem foi consultada e contribuiu diretamente dando entrevistas e passando dados específicos de interesse local. Como resultado direto da pressão provocada pela publicação do mapa, foram promovidas diversas audiências públicas, além de requisições de deputados federais, estaduais e vereadores que pediam providências aos órgãos responsáveis pela fiscalização da qualidade da água para consumo humano. Um destes apelos chegou ao Ministério da Justiça, que acionou o Instituto Nacional de Criminalística da Polícia Federal para refazer os passos da reportagem e periciar os dados do Sisagua. Cinco meses após a publicação do mapa, 300 empresas de saneamento básico foram notificadas a apresentar um plano de adequação e convidadas a assinar um Termo de Ajustamento de Conduta. O problema foi identificado em mais de mil municípios. Em contato com o Ministério da Justiça, a reportagem obteve a confirmação de que a operação foi originada pela repercussão do Mapa da Água.
2023-s-0041.tools: Scraping, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, Python

2023-s-0041.summaryJa: 水道地図は,健康省のデータから2018年から2020年の間に,水道から出ている水道に,企業や供給機関が,化学や放射性物質を限界を超えた量で特定した町村を明らかにしています. ツールはまた,同じ物質が3年間にわたって最大濃度を超えた場所に対して最大警戒を強調する. 専門家によると,最も懸念されるケースは連続汚染である.
2023-s-0041.impactJa: 公開関心は視聴者,再刊,影響によって証明される. 報告書は,リポート・ブラジルウェブサイトだけで400,000件以上のユニークなマップの閲覧とその内容,およびウェブサイト,テレビチャンネル,ラジオ局の600件以上の再刊および報告が示されている. 20件以上の場合,このレポートは,インタビューを行い,現地に関心のある特定のデータを直接提供し,調査が行われた. 地図の公開によって引き起こされた圧力によって,連邦,州,議会の議員の要請に加えて,水質の監視を担当する機関に措置を要請する公聴会が促進されました.これらの呼びかけの一つは司法省に届きました. 基本衛生事業者300社に適格化計画を提出し,行動調整規約に署名するよう通知された.この問題は1,000以上の町村で特定された.司法省の連絡から,報告は水地図の影響によって発生したという確認を得た.

2023-s-0043.summary: How harmful is Brussels for your health? - The maps show that some neighbourhoods suffer from a triple penalty: low incomes, poor health and a polluted environment. - The analyses confirm that the three inequalities (housing, health, environment) reinforce each other. - The experts add that it is necessary to look beyond the statistics to understand the extent of the problem in Brussels. The «Ailing Brussels» study examines the state of health of the inhabitants of Brussels – the capital of Flanders, Belgium and Europe.
2023-s-0043.impact: We haven't made any big discoveries in this article. The inequalities highlighted in this story were more or less known by everyone living in Brussels. We simply objectivised them, personalised the statistics and put them in context. The article is interactive and allow people to enter their address (70% of the reader did enter their information). In total 55k people have read the article which for Medor (small belgian indenpendant edition) is pretty high.

2023-s-0043.impactJa: この記事では大きな発見はしていません. この記事では強調された不平等はブリュッセルに住むすべての人に知られていました. 私たちは単にそれらを客観化し,統計を個別にして文脈にしました. この記事はインタラクティブで,人々が自分のアドレスを入力できるようにします (読者の70%は自分の情報を入力しました).

2023-s-0044.summary: Latin America has become a dumping ground for plastics from other countries. For more than six months, we analyzed how thousands of tons of this waste arrive in Mexico, Peru, Ecuador, Chile and Colombia from the United States and other European Union countries, with the promise of being recycled. The garbage enters customs through a commercial exchange that lacks transparency. Poor oversight by the authorities prevents the final destination of this waste from being known.
2023-s-0044.impact: It helped the public to know, to understand and measure the problem of plastic waste importations. Unlike the reports on the subject published by some organizations, with this work we share information about the companies responsible for this trade, we talk about the omissions of the authorities and the gaps that can give rise to organized crime.

2023-s-0045.summary: The story is the fruit of months of intense research, interviews and studies about how Nigerian bakers are adopting the puree from a new breed of potato called orange-fleshed sweet potato (OFSP) in bread-making as a cheap, timely intervention in mitigating steep costs of baking materials. The development is coming at a time food inflation is hitting record highs and the costs of wheat are forcing many bakeries to shut down. That is compelling bakers to improvise various foods from the nutrition-dense spud that is making affordable innovative food products available to low-income Nigerian households.
2023-s-0045.impact: The report is having a far-reaching impact in combating food insecurity in Nigeria, which spends the largest part of its annual food import bill on wheat. Maryann Okoli, who runs the bakery that produces the most OFSP bread in Nigeria and who was the main baker that was interviewed for the reporting project, said she was inundated with calls from all over Nigeria after the report was published. Bakers grappling with steep costs of baking materials contacted her and requested she arrange training sessions for them where they could learn several foods that could be innovated from OFSP puree. Okoli, through her training sessions, is helping create awareness of the health benefits of the potato and its products, the impact that could have in boosting profitability in the baking/confectionery business and how innovations in the OFSP value chain could help keep bakers in business at a time a good number of them are going under. Within weeks of publishing the report, BBC Africa contacted us at PREMIUM TIMES, asking us to link them up with Okoli with a view to doing a documentary on her OFSP bread and her other efforts in enhancing the potato's value addition. She later said the BBC was firming up plans to produce the documentary. Schools in Nigeria are including both OFSP bread and porridge made from the potato in their school feeding programmes in an effort to provide affordable nutrition to pupils. World-renowned economist and Johns Hopkins University scholar Professor Steve Hanke shared and referenced the story on Twitter while making commentary on inflation in Ghana. The International Potato Center also shared the story on its website.
2023-s-0045.summaryJa: この話は,ナイジェリアのパン屋がパンを作るのにオレンジ肉の甘いパン豆 (OFSP) と呼ばれる新しい種類のジャガイモから作られたピュレーを,パンを作るのに安価で時間通りに介入して,パンを作る材料の急激なコストを軽減する方法としてどのように採用しているかを数ヶ月間の研究,インタビュー,研究の結果です. 開発は,食料インフレが記録的な高値に達し,小麦のコストが多くのパン屋を閉鎖することを強要している. ナイジェリアの低所得家庭に格安な革新的な食品を提供している栄養豊富なスパッドから食品を即興に作るよう焼き屋を促しています
2023-s-0045.impactJa: この報告書は,ナイジェリアの食糧不安全対策に大きく影響を与えている.ナイジェリアは毎年輸入料のほとんどを小麦に費やしている.この報告書が公表された後,ナイジェリア全域から電話が寄せられ,ナイジェリアで最もOFSPパンを生産するパン屋を運営しているメアリーアン・オコリ氏は,報告プロジェクトのためにインタビューを受けた主なパン屋だった. 焼物料の高額なコストを抱えているパン屋たちは彼女に連絡し,OFSPのピュレーから革新できるいくつかの食品を学ぶためのトレーニングセッションを組織するよう頼んだ. オコリは,彼女の研修会を通じて,ジャガイモとその製品の健康上の利点,パンと菓子業の収益性の向上に及ぼす影響,そして,多くのパン屋が倒産している間に,OFSPの価値チェーンにおけるイノベーションがパン屋をビジネスに維持するのにどのように役立つかを意識を高めることに貢献しています. 報告書を公開してから数週間後,BBCアフリカはプレミアムタイムズで連絡し,Okoliと連絡を取り,OFSPパンに関するドキュメンタリー映画や,ジャガイモの価値増やմանための他の取り組みを制作するよう頼みました.その後,BBCがドキュメンタリー映画制作計画を強化していると彼女は語った.ナイジェリアの学校では,生徒に格安な栄養を提供するために,OFSPパンとジャガイモから作られたポウージーの両方を学校の食事プログラムに組み込んでいます. 世界的に有名な経済学者であり,ジョンズ・ホプキンス大学学者であるスティーブ・ハンケ教授は,ガーナにおけるインフレについてコメントしている間に,ツイッターでこの話を共有し,参照した.

2023-s-0046.summary: This project uses IRS tax-exempt organization data to examine the philanthropy of Jan Koum, the Ukrainian-born multi-billionaire who founded WhatsApp. Koum is known for being reclusive and he has disappeared from public eye over the past five years. But our analysis of IRS records filed by his foundation reveals that he has donated at least $180 million, mostly to Jewish causes in the United States and Israel. The analysis also sheds light on Koum's ideological bent, naming the controversial charities that have received funding from Koum's foundation.
2023-s-0046.impact: The project was widely reported on across the Jewish media in the United States and around the world, particularly in Israel. Communal priorities in the Jewish world are dominated by major charitable donors and so bringing one out of the shadows makes for a more informed public.
2023-s-0046.summaryJa: このプロジェクトは,WhatsAppを設立したウクライナ生まれの億万長者,Jan Koumの慈善活動を調査するために,IRSの税免団体データを利用しています.このプロジェクトは,WhatsAppを設立したウクライナ生まれの億万長者,Jan Koumの慈善活動を調査します. The analysis also sheds light on Koum's ideological bent, naming the controversial charities that have received funding from Koum's foundation. この分析は, Koum's ideological bentを明らかにし, Koum's foundationから資金を受け取った論争の的的的な慈善団体を名付けている.
2023-s-0046.impactJa: プロジェクトについては米国と世界中のユダヤメディア,特にイスラエルで広く報道されました.ユダヤ系世界のコミュニティー優先事項は主要な慈善事業者によって支配されており,影から外出することでより知的な市民が生まれます.

2023-s-0047.summary: The year-long analysis of court transcripts published by the Federal Court of Canada detailed what Nigerian asylum seekers tell Canadian authorities about their country. We analysed 300 cases, numbering about 5,000 pages, of the 900 published by the court and extracted details about each of the applicants and their reasons for seeking upward mobility in Canada. Using pivot table and other excel commands we were able to determine the reasons the immigrants are giving. We categorised them into thirteen. Majority of the applicants said they were driven because of the persecution related to sexual orientation and religious and political persecution.
2023-s-0047.impact: The story tapped government officials on the enormity of the efforts that must be put in place to make Nigeria safer for all class of people as well those in the diaspora. In its first week of publication, the story reached over 50,000 readers, the most read for the week of publication on Premium Times website. It triggered reactions among Nigerians, especially on Twitter, with dozens of users sharing it on their accounts with over a million of cumulative followers. Many of these said they've been educated (https://mobile.twitter.com/search?q=Canada%20Rush%20premiumtimesng.com&src=typed_query&f=top) and would make informed decisions when seeking refuge abroad. Likewise, the story picked the interests of Reaching Out Assisting Refugees (ROAR), a Vancouver Island community group working to resettle LGBTQ refugees. Likewise, we got reaction from journalists colleagues who said they were impressed by the efforts put into the story, with some saying they were inspired to tell more of such important stories. The story was awarded best story in the online category of this year's Migration Reporter Competition organized by the United Nations International Organisation for Migration. It was also adjudged as Premium Times story of the week and month it was published, and now in running for the newspaper's story of the year.
2023-s-0047.tools: Canvas, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Venngage
2023-s-0047.summaryJa: カナダ連邦裁判所が公表した裁判所の記録の1年間の分析では,ナイジェリア人亡命者達がカナダ当局に彼らの国について何を伝えているのか詳細に説明されました.我々は,裁判所が公表した900件のうち約5000ページの300件を分析し,各申請者とその理由について詳細を抽出しました.カナダで上昇移動を求める理由について.ピボートテーブルやその他のエクセルコマンドを使用して,移民が与える理由を決定することができました. 申請者の多くは性的指向や宗教・政治的迫害による追放されたと答えました
2023-s-0047.impactJa: この記事は,政府関係者に対し,ナイジェリアをあらゆる階級の人々にとっても,また,移住者にとっても安全にするための取り組みの大きさを指摘した.出版の最初の週間に,この記事は5万人以上の読者に達し,プレミアムタイムズウェブサイトで出版の週で最も多く読まれました. 海外での避難を求めたときに知的な決断をするという.同例では,バンクーバー島コミュニティーグループであるリッチングアウト・アシスタント・リフギエス (ROAR) の利益も挙げられた. また,ジャーナリストの同僚からも反応がありました. 彼らはこの記事に付加された努力に感銘を受けたと,何人かは,このような重要な物語をさらに伝えるために励まされたと語った.この記事は,国連国際移住機関が組織した今年のオンラインレポート者コンテストのオンラインカテゴリーで最高の記事に賞を受賞しました. 出版された週と月のプレミアムタイムズ記事として評価され今では新聞の年度記事に候補しています

2023-s-0048.summary: Miramos el aumento de los homicidios en Chile desde distintos lados. Recogimos miles de datos de fuentes diversas; conversamos con fiscales, policías, defensores públicos, autoridades de gobierno, trabajadores sociales, familiares de víctimas y de victimarios, vecinos, personal de hospitales y de establecimientos educacionales. El resultado es este especial periodístico en el que con cifras, visualizaciones, mapas, reportajes en profundidad y un podcast con la historia de dos bandas de menores que se disputan la calle a tiros, intentamos dar luces sobre un fenómeno que crece en número, pero mucho más en complejidad.
2023-s-0048.impact: A poco de haber sido publicado (hace tres días) el sitio ya tiene más de 3 mil visitas y el tema se analizó en programas de radio y televisión. Aún no se ven medidas concretas de parte de las autoridades sobre temas tan sensibles como, por ejemplo, que 1 de cada 4 causas de homicidios no tiene imputado (perpetrador) conocido y que los organismos encargados de la materia no se ponen de acuerdo en las cifras reales de homicidios en el país. Hay una cifra en negro.
2023-s-0048.tools: Animation, Scraping, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Shorthand para puesta en página, Adobe Audition para podcast, Mapbox y Tableu para mapa territorial, Flourish para visualizaciones.

2023-s-0048.summaryJa: 私たちはチリの殺人事件の増加を様々な角度から観察し様々な情報源から何千ものデータを集めました検察官や警察官,公務員,政府当局者,社会労働者,被害者や被害者の家族,隣人,病院や教育機関職員と話をしました結果は統計やビジュアル地図詳細な報道ポーダックでストリートで銃撃を振るう2つの少年集団の話を描き出しました数は増加する現象が複雑化も増えています
2023-s-0048.impactJa: 3日前 (公開後) サイトは3千人以上訪問され,ラジオやテレビ番組で話題が分析された.例えば4人の殺人事件の原因のうち1人が未知容疑者 (犯人) を抱えていることや,この事件を担当する機関が国内における殺人事件の実際の数字に一致していないことなど,非常に敏感な問題について当局から具体的な措置がまだ見られない.

2023-s-0049.summary: The official free visa agreement between the two countries guarantees the right of mobility and residence for their citizens using any identification papers. Yet most applicants never make it to the counter. They are forced into paying fees to agents, who are capable of facilitating the swift application processing needed to obtain a visa that is otherwise free of charge. In addition, the process has created a buoyant underground market for selling required documents, including forged medical forms
2023-s-0049.impact: The applicant did not give consent to publish details of the application.
2023-s-0049.summaryJa: 公式の免許ビザ協定は,いかなる身分証明書も使って,市民の移動と居住権を保証する.しかし,ほとんどの申請者は決してカウンターにそれを行うことができません. 彼らは代理人に料金を支払うことに強制されています. さらに,そのプロセスが必要書類,包括的に偽造医療形式の販売のための活発な地下市場を創出しました
2023-s-0049.impactJa: 申請者は申請の詳細を公開する同意をしなかった.

2023-s-0050.summary: In 2022, India was again battling with the new variants of Coronavirus. Every day more than 200,000 people were testing positive for the virus. India’s crippled healthcare was trying its best to get the country back on track with a massive vaccination drive from urban to rural areas and many states in the country had already imposed restrictions to avoid further spread of the infection. India was struggling to vaccinate people throughout the country. This rollout would have been impossible without the healthcare workers who traversed hills and mountains to reach every home, making vaccination shots available to the population.
2023-s-0050.impact: The project gave awareness to thousands of India about the importance of vaccination to fight the deadly coronavirus. It highlighted the motivation of the nurses who were trekking mountains without proper facilities to make sure that vaccine reaches every home. In India, which hosts 1,413,347,820, it was difficult to vaccinate such a huge number but the project showed how it all was done even in the remotest places of the country.
2023-s-0050.summaryJa: 2022年,インドはまた新型コロナウイルスと闘っていました.毎日20万人以上がウイルスに陽性でした.インドの障害のある医療は都市から農村まで大規模なワクチン接種 अभियानで国を再び軌道に乗せるために最善を尽くしていました.多くの州では既に感染拡大を防ぐために制限を課していました.インドは全国で人々をワクチン接種に苦労していました. 医療従事者が山や山を横切って家庭にワクチンを接種できるようにしなければ実現できなかったでしょう
2023-s-0050.impactJa: このプロジェクトは,致命的なコロナウイルスと戦うためにワクチン接種の重要性を何千人ものインドの人々に知覚させました.適切な施設のない山を歩いていた看護師の動機を強調し,ワクチンがすべての家に届くことを確認しました. 1,413,347,820人が住んでいますが,このような膨大な数を接種することは困難でしたが,このプロジェクトは,それがどのように行われているかを示す.

2023-s-0051.summary: The story puts under the spotlight three interrelated subjects In Jordan and Lebanon. Waste management, international environmental aid, and the waste management impact on the environment. The story revealed that Jordan and Lebanon are wasting billions of dollars by burying or openly dumping domestic waste. The story reveals how the major industrialized countries are still evading their responsibilities toward climate change. And Finally, I explored the possible practical solutions and their potential environmental benefits.
2023-s-0051.impact: The project is one month old. The first audience reaction was astonishment about how much domestic waste is worth. I hope it will help push the upcoming regulations and the government's plans for waste management.

2023-s-0053.summary: “The Price Kids Pay” is the broadest look at school-based ticketing in the United States, documenting roughly 12,000 tickets issued to students over three years as officials exploited a loophole in Illinois law to punish children. Instead of fining students directly, which is banned, schools referred students to police, who issued tickets for violating local ordinances. The team built a [first-of-its-kind database](https://projects.propublica.org/illinois-school-police-tickets-fines/) for public use. Ticketing, reporters determined, was often disproportionately applied to Black students. And reporters identified dozens of districts that had broken a state law that explicitly prohibits schools from referring students to be ticketed for truancy.
2023-s-0053.impact: “The Price Kids Pay” had swift and powerful impact. Hours after the investigation’s first story was published, the state superintendent told schools to stop ticketing students. The next day, Illinois Gov. J.B. Pritzker vowed to make changes to prevent further harm to students. State lawmakers pledged to revisit the legislation that had tried — and failed — to prevent students from being fined at school. [The Illinois attorney general later launched an investigation](https://www.propublica.org/article/illinois-will-investigate-possible-civil-rights-violations-in-student-ticketing) into whether the state’s largest high school district had violated students’ civil rights in issuing hundreds of tickets. Officials had noticed that the district stood out in the database that ProPublica and the Tribune built and published, both for the number of tickets issued there and for racial disparities. And [the Illinois comptroller said her office](https://www.propublica.org/article/illinois-school-discipline-ticket-debt-collection) would ban local governments from using a state program to collect debt from students who were ticketed for truancy. Some school district officials were shocked to learn how commonplace the ticketing of students had become in their high schools — and how costly the practice was for many families. Some vowed immediate changes. Finally, some municipalities reduced the fines associated with violations of local ordinances. One severed ties with a hearing officer after reporters detailed his caustic, dismissive treatment of ticketed students. Another story that prompted change exposed how employees at a school for students with behavioral disabilities frequently called police — and sought students’ arrest — for misbehavior. After receiving reporters’ questions, the state board of education conducted an on-site visit at the Garrison School, confirmed an overreliance on police and plans to require intensive training. Newsrooms across the state, including at least one high school newspaper, used the data reporters had collected to publish their own stories about ticketing.
2023-s-0053.tools: Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, R, RStudio, * Google Refine * PDF2Text * Tabula * Adobe Acrobat Pro
2023-s-0053.authors: Jodi S. Cohen, Jennifer Smith Richards
2023-s-0053.summaryJa: 価格・児童給与は,米国における学校でのチケット販売に関する最も広範な見方であり,当局者がイリノイ州法における漏洞を活用して子供たちを罰する際に3年間で学生に発行された約12,000のチケットを記録している.学校は学生を直接罰金をかけることなく,警察に送った.警察は地元の規則を違反したためチケットを発行した. チームでは公用に使われる [その種の最初のデータベース] (https://projects.propublica.org/illinois-school-police-tickets-fines/) を構築しました記者によると,黒人学生に対してチケットがしばしば不均衡に適用されていました.そして記者らは,学校が真偽の学生を紹介することを明示的に禁止する州法を違反した数十の地区を特定しました.
2023-s-0053.impactJa: <unk> 価格・子供給付<unk>は迅速かつ強力な影響を与えた.調査の最初の物語が公表された数時間後,州監督は学校に学生のチケット販売を停止するよう指示した.翌日,イリノイ州知事JBプリッツカーは学生へのさらなる損害を防ぐために変更を行うことを誓いました.州立法者は学生を学校で罰金を免れるように試みた法律を再検討すると誓いました. [イリノイ州司法長官が後に調査を開始した]https://www.propublica.org/article/illinois-will-investigate-possible-civil-rights-violations-in-student-ticketing) 州最大の高校区が何百ものチケットを発行することで学生の市民権を侵害したか否かについて地方自治区はプロパブリカとトリビューンが作成し公開したデータベースで,その場で発行されたチケットの数と人種差異の両方で,区画が顕著であることを知っていました.そして[イリノイ州検察官は彼女の事務所を語った]https://www.propublica.org/article/illinois-school-discipline-ticket-debt-collection) は,真偽のためにチケットを被った学生からの借金を徴収するために州政府プログラムを使用することを禁止する. 校区の役員の中には,高校で学生のチケット販売がどれほど一般的になったか,そして多くの家庭にとってこの慣行がどれほど高価であったかを知ってショックを受けた.何人かは即時変更を約束した.最終的に,一部の自治体は,地元の規則違反に関連する罰金を削減した.記者たちがチケット付きの学生に対する彼の不当な扱いについて詳細を詳細に説明した後に,聴聞官との関係を断った. 行動障害のある学生のための学校の従業員が警察に電話して,不適切な行動のために学生を逮捕することを求めたという別の物語が暴露された.記者からの質問を受けた後,州教育委員会はガーリソン学校に現場訪問を行い,警察への過剰依存を確認し,集中訓練を必要とする計画を立てました. 州中のニュースルームは,少なくとも高校新聞を含む, ジャーナリストが収集したデータを利用してチケット販売に関する自身の記事を公開しました.

2023-s-0054.summary: I scraped the Philippines' freedom of information portal to assess how many of the requests are being granted or denied under former president Rodrigo Duterte. The story contains my findings and reporting.
2023-s-0054.impact: The project was published by PCIJ in time for World Press Freedom Day at the time. One of our findings showed how the FOI website became an avenue for people to ask for cash assistance at the height of pandemic lockdowns. It shed light to what was already anecdotally known fact that people were using the website to ask for assistance at the time, which was being scrutinized by congress.
2023-s-0054.tools: Scraping, Adobe Creative Suite, CSV, Python
2023-s-0054.summaryJa: フィリピンの情報の自由ポータルを削除してフィリピンの元大統領ロドリゴ・ドゥテルテ政権下で申請のいくつが認められ,否決されているかを評価しました

2023-s-0056.summary: In April 2022, Carbon Brief produced an analysis looking at the past decade of editorials in UK newspapers that discuss relevant topics about climate change. Drawing from Carbon Brief’s database of more than 1,300 editorials, which are the formal “voice” of a newspaper, this work examines how the language used to describe human-caused climate change, as well as renewables, fracking and nuclear power, has shifted since 2011. The interactive article features multiple data visualisations, evidencing the shift in sentiment over time, and includes animations, video and other inline designs.
2023-s-0056.impact: This analysis marked an important era in climate change in the national press, published soon after COP26 Glasgow, 2021. Media coverage of climate change was at its peak, and the previous decade had seen a seismic shift in attitudes within the editorials of many major newspapers, from climate scepticism and anti-renewables, to the green recovery and net-zero targets. The COP26 President Alok Sharma, tweeted “Interesting analysis from @CarbonBrief about the evolving attitude of UK newspapers to tackling #climatechange”. In a keynote address at the Society of Editors conference 2022, Sharma went on to say: “Analysis by Carbon Brief…shows that the number of editorials in UK newspapers calling for more action to tackle climate change has quadrupled in three years…”. The international climate finance lead for COP26 Camilla Born, described it as “...a fascinating read…”. Journalists shared the piece with their audiences too. Chief lead writer at the Times, Simon Nixon, tweeted: “Interesting analysis of shifting UK newspaper editorial attitudes towards climate change. Also pleasing to see newspaper leading articles being treated with the seriousness that they unquestionably deserve”. Other reporters from the Washington Post and the Independent also praised the work. Press Gazette wrote up the piece. The story, combined with the database that serves the analysis, has been viewed over 20,000 times since publication. The database has subsequently gained a Google page position of ~4, resulting in an increase of people able to find and search through 1000’s of climate editorials.
2023-s-0056.tools: Animation, Scraping, JQuery, Json, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets
2023-s-0056.authors: Josh Gabbatiss, Sylvia Hayes, Tom Prater, Joe Goodman
2023-s-0056.summaryJa: 2022年4月,Carbon Briefは気候変動に関する関連トピックを議論する英国新聞の10年間を分析した.この研究は,新聞の公式の"声"であるCarbon Briefの1,300以上の編集資料データベースから,再生可能エネルギー,フラクリング,原子力等を記述するために使用された言語が2011年以降どのように変化したか調査しています. インタラクティブな記事には複数のデータビジュアライゼーションがあり,時間とともに感情の変化を証明し,アニメーション,ビデオ,その他のインラインデザインが含まれています.
2023-s-0056.impactJa: この分析は2021年のグラスゴー会議26年 (COP26) の直後に発表された全国報道において,気候変動に関する重要な時代を象徴した. 気候変動に関するメディア報道はピークに達し,前10年は,多くの主要新聞の編集部における態度が地震的な変化を目の当たりにしました. COP26議長アロック・シャーマはツイートした. 気候変動対策に関する英国の新聞の態度について @CarbonBriefから興味深い分析を発表した. 社団編集者会議2022の基調演説で,シャーマはこう語った. 炭素・ブリフによる分析は...気候変動に対処するためにより多くの行動を求める英国の新聞の編集者の数は3年間で4倍になったことを示しています... 気候変動に関する英国新聞の編集者の態度の変化の興味深い分析.また,新聞の主要記事が,疑いなく,それに値する重さで扱われていることを見るのも嬉しいです. ワシントンポストとインディペンデントの他の記者は,この作品を賞賛した.プレスガゼット紙はこの作品を書き上げた.この記事は,分析を担当するデータベースと組み合わせて,出版以来,20万回以上閲覧されている.このデータベースはその後Googleページポジションを4位を獲得し,1000万の気候編集を検索し,検索することができた人々の増加をもたらした.

2023-s-0057.summary: 2022 marks the 50th anniversary of the return of the Okinawa Islands to Japan. At this commemorative time, through this project, we review the historical changes in the Okinawa Islands since the 14th century. Being part of the First Island Chain, from the emergence of an independent country to the development of belonging to different countries, Okinawa Islands have passively accepted the fate arranged by others in the past 500 years.
2023-s-0057.impact: Similar to Okinawa Islands, Taiwan is part of the First Island Chain. Both have a close relationship and many exchanges in history. In addition, as tensions rise in the Pacific region with the growth of China and Russia's invasion of Ukraine, Okinawans are concerned that they might once more end up on the front lines. By introducing the fate of the Okinawa Islands over the past 500 years, we aim to inspire Taiwanese readers to reflect on the future of Taiwan.
2023-s-0057.authors: 羅元祺, 林奕甫, 陳育暄, 松村梨紗, 洪塵
2023-s-0057.summaryJa: 2022年は沖縄諸島が日本に帰還した50周年を迎えます.この記念的な時期に,このプロジェクトを通じて,私たちは14世紀以降の沖縄諸島における歴史的変化をレビューします.第一島連鎖の一部として,独立した国の出現から異なる国の発展まで,沖縄諸島は過去500年間に他者が決められた運命を受け入れています.
2023-s-0057.impactJa: 沖縄諸島と同様に,台湾は第一島連鎖の一部である.両国は密接な関係と歴史上の多くの交流を持っています. さらに,中国とロシアのウクライナの侵略の成長とともに太平洋地域での緊張が上昇するにつれて,沖縄の人々は再び戦線に終えることを懸念しています.過去500年の沖縄諸島の運命を紹介することで,台湾の読者を台湾の未来について考えるよう励ます.

2023-s-0058.summary: A visualisation evaluating the global impact of The Warming Stripes graphic by climate scientist Ed Hawkins. The visualisation assesses how Hawkins’ graphic has grown in popularity over time and has been used as a visual symbol for the climate movement, with stripes appearing on a vast collection of items across the world. Google Trends data was used to track search interest for terms related to the Warming Stripes, with more than 80 notable uses identified and analysed to reveal trends, patterns and connections. Shown in the finished product is a timeline of search term popularity, interest by country and categorisation.
2023-s-0058.impact: Claire Santoro and I were asked to collaborate on this project which would be featured within the Nightingale magazine and the response so far has been overwhelmingly positive. The Nightingale magazine was born out of the data visualisation society which is a non-profit organisation that supports the growth, refinement, and the expansion of data visualisation knowledge regardless of expertise level. It has a following of over 236.6k across LinkedIn, Twitter and instagram. The magazine is being distributed currently (December 2022) so the impact of the audience isn't visible yet however the anticipation on twitter after the release of the first issue is exciting. Because the data visualisation and article theme covers climate data and global warming activism, the hope would be that it continues to spur people on in using the Warming Stripes as a symbol for change. My hope is that after viewing the data visualisation, readers realises how powerful the unique Warming Stripes graph can be and how it can have such global impact on society despite breaking all the traditional graph rules (no axis, no labels etc) with the aim to inspire others to follow suit.
2023-s-0058.tools: Scraping, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Sheets, CSV, Flourish
2023-s-0058.authors: Chesca Kirkland - Data Vizulisation Designer Claire Santoro - Article Author Jason Forrest - Nightingale Managing Editor Julie Brunet - Nightingale Art Director
2023-s-0058.summaryJa: 気候科学者エド・ホーキンズの"The Warming Stripes"グラフィックによる世界の影響を評価するビジュアライゼーション.このビジュアライゼーションは,ホーキンズグラフィックが時間とともにどのように人気を得てきたかを評価し,気候変動運動の視覚的なシンボルとして使用されている. Google Trends のデータは,Warming Stripes に関連する用語に対する検索関心を追跡するために使用され,傾向,パターン,関連を明らかにするために 80 以上の顕著な用途が特定され,分析されました.完成品に表示されたのは,検索用語の人気,国別の関心,分類のタイムラインです.
2023-s-0058.impactJa: クレア・サントロと私はこのプロジェクトに協力するよう依頼されました.このプロジェクトではナイトイゲール誌に掲載され,これまでのところの反応は圧倒的に肯定的なものでした.ナイトイゲール誌はデータビジュアライゼーション社会から生まれた.この雑誌は,専門レベルに関係なくデータビジュアライゼーション知識の成長,精錬,拡大を支援する非営利組織です.LinkedIn,Twitter,Instagramで236.6k以上のフォロワーを持っています. 雑誌は現在 (2022年12月) に配布されているため,視聴者の影響はまだ目に見えないが,最初の号がリリースされた後,ツイッターで期待はエキサイティングです.データビジュアライゼーションと記事テーマは気候データと地球温暖化活動をカバーしているため,希望は,温暖化ストライプを変化のシンボルとして利用する人々に刺激を与えることを継続することを望みます. データの視覚化を見て読者は独自の"ウォーミングストライプス"グラフがどれほど強力で伝統的なグラフルール (軸なし,ラベルなしなど) を破ったにもかかわらず社会にいかにグローバルな影響を与えるか認識できるようになることを願っています

2023-s-0059.summary: "Drug crime is internationalizing, getting more violent and involving billions of euros. That money is taking hold of our society. It is one of the major problems of our time", says criminologist Henk Ferwerda. Governments are allocating funds to tackle subversive crime. But it is a problem that remains largely invisible. For example, drug money is laundered through shady shops or by recruiting vulnerable youths at schools. RTL Nieuws created The Underworld Map to address a problem most people do not see. Journalists developed a model to measure the vulnerability of residents, businesses and municipalities, thus making the invisible visible.
2023-s-0059.impact: Our research was hot news for over a week. We produced several online articles based on the outcomes and specific phenomena we found. Most of these also led to items on television, even on prime time for a public of over one million viewers. Our articles and maps online have been read and viewed by more than 750,000 visitors. Our investigation led to several questions from members of the House of Representatives, who wanted to know how Minister of Justice and Security Dilan Yesilgöz will tackle the problems outlined earlier. The minister herself also responded to the inquiry and stated that the investigation makes it clear that criminal subversion takes place all over the country and is often closer to home than many people think. In addition, many experts and policy makers from Dutch provinces and municipalities have asked us to work with the results on a local level. Many local and regional journalists have also used our research to write regionally specific articles based on the outcomes. We also recieved lots of compliments from other media outlets. A colleague on LinkedIn wrote that investigative journalism 'has been taken to a higher level' thanks to our research.
2023-s-0059.summaryJa: "麻薬犯罪は国際化され暴力が増加し数十億ドルもかかっていますそのお金は私たちの社会を奪い取っていますこれは私たちの時代の大きな問題です" 犯罪学者ヘンク・フェルワーダは言います. 政府が破壊的な犯罪に対処するために資金を割り当てています. しかしそれはほとんど見えない問題です. 例えば,麻薬資金は影の店や学校で脆弱な若者を採用することによって洗浄されています. RTLニュースは,ほとんどの人々が見ていない問題を解決するために"地下世界地図"を作成しましたジャーナリストは住民,企業,自治体の脆弱性を測定するモデルを開発し,目に見えないものを目に見せるようにしました
2023-s-0059.impactJa: 私たちの研究は1週間以上に渡って熱いニュースでした. 私たちは発見した結果や特定の現象に基づいてオンラインでいくつかの記事を制作しました. そして,その多くはテレビで放送されたものになりました. 視聴者数は100万人以上です. 私たちの記事や地図はオンラインで 75万人以上の訪問者が読み取り,閲覧しています. 司法と安全保障大臣のジラン・イエシルグゾスが先ほど述べた問題に対処する方法を知りたいため, 議会の議員から多くの質問が寄せられました. 大臣自身も調査に答えて,調査は犯罪破壊が全国で起きていることを明らかにし,多くの人々が思っているよりも近寄りの場所だと述べた. また,オランダの省や市政府からの多くの専門家や政策立案者が地域レベルで成果を研究するよう依頼してきました. 多くの地域や地域ジャーナリストも,成果に基づいて地域的に特定な記事を執筆するために私たちの研究を利用しました. また,他のメディアから多くの褒め言葉も受け取りました.

2023-s-0061.summary: New York, one of the most expensive cities in the world, is also home to some of the poorest families in the U.S. As the pandemic roils the economy in ways that disproportionately affect low-wage workers and people of color, more and more families in the city are struggling to get by. In this special report, the NYCity News Service, part of the Craig Newmark Graduate School of Journalism at CUNY, documents the spread of housing insecurity and the need for government-aid programs. We also share the data underlying our reporting.
2023-s-0061.impact: The project shined a light on how the housing costs increases slamming New Yorkers in recent years reached a new level of crisis during the pandemic, as many people in the areas hardest hit by COVID grappled with illness, unemployment and an emergency safety net plagued by gaping holes.
2023-s-0061.tools: Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV, Python
