2023-s-0491.summary: Portugal foi a eleições e todas as sondagens davam uma ligeira vantagem ao Partido Socialista (PS). Mas a noite eleitoral deu-nos uma surpresa, e o partido conseguiu uma maioria absoluta na assembleia, ganhando em 252 de 308 concelhos. Quisemos mapear as vitórias e derrotas eleitorais.
2023-s-0491.impact: O projecto foi publicado logo após a noite eleitoral e permitiu ir um pouco além do “horse race journalism”, percebendo fenómenos locais de alguns partidos. Uma análise micro quando o foco de grande parte dos jornais estava na análise macro permitiu-nos resumir as grandes conclusões da noite eleitoral num scroller. O artigo foi dos mais lidos no rescaldo da noite eleitoral.
2023-s-0491.authors: Rui Barros, José Volta e Pinto
2023-s-0491.summaryJa: 選挙はポルトガルに行われた.すべての民意調査は社会党 (PS) にわずかな優位性を与えた. しかし選挙の夜は私たちに驚きを与え,党は議会で絶対的な多数を獲得し,308の郡区のうち252に勝利しました.選挙の勝利と敗北を地図にしたいと思いました.
2023-s-0491.impactJa: 選挙夜直後に発表されたこのプロジェクトは,いくつかの政党の局所現象を認識し, <unk>orse race journalism<unk>を少し超えて行きました. メディアの多くの新聞がマクロ分析に焦点を当てたとき,マイクロ分析によって,選挙夜の大切な結論をスクロールでまとめることができました.

2023-s-0492.summary: O especial revela as desigualdades de distribuição da malha cicloviária de Fortaleza, problemas de fiscalização e manutenção da infraestrutura. "Ciclomobilidade para quem?", dividido em três episódios, mostra que na cidade detentora de uma das mais longas malhas cicloviárias do país, apenas 7% das vias dos bairros com menor IDH têm acesso a esse modal. Além de expor como o órgão fiscalizador oculta dados que vão de detalhamento desse investimento, passando por gastos com ações educativas, total de multas aplicadas e valor arrecadado.
2023-s-0492.impact: Os políticos e gestores ligados a agência de trânsito ficaram incomodados com as matérias que sairam sobre o assunto, o que gerou um impacto positivo dentro da redação e estimulou outros colegas a se desafiarem em materiais de fôlego.
2023-s-0492.authors: Alexandre Cajazeira, Gabriela Custódio, Thays Lavor, Pedro Silva, Michele Medeiros, Isac Bernardo, Critiane Frota, Luciana Pimenta, Arthur Gadelha, Aurélio Alves, Samya Nara e Raphael Góes.
2023-s-0492.summaryJa: 特別報告はフォートレーザの自転車網の配分不平等,インフラ整備の問題について明らかにしています. "誰のための自転車利用可能?"は,3話に分かれ,国内で最長な自転車網を持つ都市では,低所得者地域での道路のわずか7%しかこのモダルの利用を可視化していないことを示しています. 監査機が投資の詳細から教育支出,罰金総額,所得額までデータを隠す方法も明らかにします
2023-s-0492.impactJa: 交通機関に連結した政治家や管理者はこの話題に話題が上がったことで困惑し報道機関にポジティブな影響を与え他の同僚が呼吸器材に挑戦するよう促しました

2023-s-0493.summary: O mês de Janeiro de 2022 foi, em Portugal,o segundo mais seco desde 2000 e o sexto desde 1931. Perante um cenário de alterações climáticas, o país depara-se com uma situação para a qual não está preparado - Invernos secos. Com recurso aos dados do Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera, imagens de satélite e fotografias dos fotojornalistas do PÚBLICO, usamos dados para mostrar como o problema está cada vez mais presente.
2023-s-0493.impact: O projecto permitiu-nos colocar em visualizações de dados um problema que só se torna visível quando é agudo - a seca. Como conseguimos acesso a uma base de dados ao nível do município e de uma série longa (desde 2000), este artigo, que recorre ao scrollytelling para contar a história da seca em Portugal em vários gráficos, oferece ainda a possibilidade de o leitor ver como o sítio onde vive é afectado pelo problema. A possibilidade de personalizar a história para o local onde vive gerou um interesse bastante grande nesta história.
2023-s-0493.authors: Rui Barros, Claudia Carvalho Silva, Miguel Manso (Fotografia), José Sérgio (Fotografia)
2023-s-0493.summaryJa: 気候変化の状況では,ポルトガルが準備ができていない状況に直面しています - 乾燥した冬.ポルトガル海と大気研究所のデータ,衛星画像,PÚBLICOの写真ジャーナリストの写真を使って,私たちはデータの利用を図に,問題がますます現れていることを示しています.
2023-s-0493.impactJa: このプロジェクトにより,急性のある状況でしか目に見えない問題である干ばつをデータビューに載せることができました. 都市レベルのデータベースと長いシリーズ (2000年以降) にアクセスできたので,この記事では,ポルトガルの干ばつの歴史を数枚のグラフで伝えるためにスクロールリッテルを活用し,また,あなたが住んでいる場所が問題によってどのように影響を受けているかを読者に見せる機会を提供します. 物語を自分の住む場所に合わせる可能性はこの物語に非常に大きな関心をもたらしました

2023-s-0494.summary: O dia 24 de Março de 2022 foi especial para os portugueses. O número de dias em democracia superava, pela primeira vez, o número de dias que o país viveu debaixo de uma ditadura. Iniciada em 1926, a ditadura é apontada como a principal razão para o atraso estrutural que o país vivia antes da entrada na União Europeia. Do analfabetismo aos esgotos, contamos em dados 14 revoluções que o país viveu com a democracia.
2023-s-0494.impact: O projecto foi muito bem-sucedido e ajudou muitos leitores - principalmente os leitores mais novos, já nascidos em democracia - a perceber a evolução e o progresso vivido pelo país em múltiplos indicadores. A grande vantagem deste projecto foi apresentar séries temporais de quase 100 anos - algo que raramente vemos.
2023-s-0494.authors: Rui Barros, José Volta e Pinto
2023-s-0494.summaryJa: 2022年3月24日はポルトガル人のために特別でした.民主主義の日数は,初めて独裁政権の下で,国が生きてきた日数を上回りました. 1926年に始まった独裁政権は,欧州連合に入国する前に,国が生きていた構造的な遅れの主要な理由として指摘されています.文盲から排水道まで,私たちはデータで,民主主義で生きてきた14回の革命を数えています.
2023-s-0494.impactJa: このプロジェクトは非常に成功し多くの読者を助けました特に民主主義に生まれた若者たちは複数の指標で国の進化と進歩を認識しましたこのプロジェクトの大きな利点はほぼ100年のタイムシリーズを紹介することでしたこれはほとんど見られません

2023-s-0495.summary: O governo português está a cumprir o que prometeu? Seleccionamos 150 medidas emblemáticas e relevantes do programa do terceiro executivo liderado por António Costa e, numa base mensal, verificamos o estado de cada uma dessas promessas, oferecendo aos leitores do Público a possibilidade de escrutinar o progresso ou cumprimento das propostas eleitorais.
2023-s-0495.impact: O projecto ainda decorre e está a ser muito bem-sucedido. Tornou-se uma ferramenta para os leitores, mas também para a própria redacção, que vai usando esta ferramenta para ir acompanhado o estado de algumas promessas e questionar o Governo sobre o seu cumprimento.
2023-s-0495.authors: Coordenação Mariana Adam, Pedro Rios e Patrícia Jesus Recolha das medidas Rui Barros, Liliana Borges, José Volta e Pinto, Miguel Dantas Desenvolvimento Rui Barros Acompanhamento das medidas Redacção do PÚBLICO
2023-s-0495.summaryJa: ポルトガル政府は約束を果たしているのでしょうか? 我々はアントニオ・コスタが率いる第三の行政当局のプログラムから150の象徴的な重要な措置を選んでおり,毎月それぞれの約束の状況を確認し,選挙提案の進展や実行を調査する機会を公衆の読者に提供しました.
2023-s-0495.impactJa: プロジェクトはまだ進行中でありとても成功していますリーダーにとっても編集部にとってもツールになりました文書の現状を把握し政府の履行を問いかけるためにこのツールを使います

2023-s-0496.summary: Through the use of satellite imagery and AI powered platforms we discovered that in the last 20 years the soy industry, presented as a solution to climate crisis because of links to veganism and the meat industry also, devastated a forest are almost equal to the whole Uruguay in the second largest river ecosystem of the Americas.
2023-s-0496.impact: The area devastated discovered through the data analysis of our investigation is such that we proved it had a direct impact in the worst drought of the Paraná River, the second largest river ecosystem after the Amazon, in 77 years.
2023-s-0496.tools: AI/Machine learning, Sensor, QGIS, Json, R
2023-s-0496.authors: ARÍSTIDES ORTIZ, CECILIA ROJAS, NACHO CATALÁN, GIBRAN MENA, FERNANDA AGUIRRE
2023-s-0496.summaryJa: 衛星画像や人工知能のプラットフォームの利用により過去20年間で豆産業は気候危機への解決策として呈され肉産業とベガニズムとの関連から森林が破壊されアメリカ大陸で2番目に大きな川生態系であるウルグアイのほぼ全面積に相当する森林が破壊されたことがわかりました
2023-s-0496.impactJa: 私たちの調査のデータ分析によって発見された荒廃地域は 77年後のパラナ川の最悪の干ばつに直接影響を与えたことを証明しました

2023-s-0497.summary: O conflito armado na Ucrânia e as suas consequências económicas geraram uma onda inflacionista um pouco por todo mundo. Quisemos perceber desde cedo como este conflito estava a afectar as finanças dos portugueses. Para tal usamos o valor de um cabaz de compras com 63 produtos para analisar como um carrinho de compras tem ficado mais caro. O tracker é actualizado numa base semanal e permite aos leitores saber quais são os produtos que mais encareceram.
2023-s-0497.impact: O projecto tornou-se uma referência para muitos leitores. Sexta-feira tornou-se o dia de ver como o cabaz de compras evolui. Para além disso, foi uma série temporal que vimos crescer a cada semana. E por isso, algumas histórias secundárias têm nascido deste trabalho, como por exemplo uma história que explica porque é que o arroz duplicou de preço num ano.
2023-s-0497.summaryJa: ウクライナでの紛争とその経済的影響は世界中にインフレの波を少し引き起こすため我々は早期にこの紛争がポルトガルの財政にどのように影響を与えているかを認識しようとしました 63の商品の購物車の価値を使って購物車がどのように高額になったかを分析しました追跡車は週ごとに更新され読者に最も高い商品を教えてくれます
2023-s-0497.impactJa: このプロジェクトは多くの読者の参考になりました金曜日は買い物市場がどのように進化しているか見られる日になりましたさらに週ごとに成長している時間軸でしたそこでこの作品から副本的な物語が生まれました例えば米が一年で価格を倍にした理由を説明する物語です

2023-s-0498.summary: The Taiwan government has long used 'Zone expropriation' as a means for public construction and large-scale development, often resulting in controversies over forced displacement of local residents. READr consolidates past Zone expropriation plans and found that 80% of the development plans were primarily for building housing. By comparing the vacancy rate of the development area, it was discovered that the vacancy rate of the Zone expropriation locations was almost always higher than the average.This result shows that the housing supply is greater than the demand, the development plan is obviously overly optimistic, and the necessity is insufficient.
2023-s-0498.impact: This report is the first one to use data and statistics, such as vacancy rates and transaction data, to prove the long-standing issue of Zone expropriation abuse in Taiwan. Unlike previous reports that only examined individual cases, this report uses comprehensive data analysis to highlight the systemic problems of Zone expropriation, which has received feedback from many domestic land-use scholars.
2023-s-0498.tools: QGIS, Google Sheets, CSV, R, RStudio
2023-s-0498.authors: Liu Yi-xin, Lee Yu-Ju, Chien Hsin-chan, Wu Man-Ru
2023-s-0498.summaryJa: 台湾政府は長い間,公共建設や大規模な開発のための手段として"区外出"を使用しており,しばしば地方住民の強制移住に関する論争を引き起こしている. READrは,過去の区外出計画を統合し,開発計画のうち80%が主に住宅建設のためのものであったことを発見した. 開発エリアの空きquoteを比較すると,ゾーン外占拠場所の空きquoteがほぼ常に平均より高いことが判明した.この結果は,住宅供給が需要よりも大きいことを示唆し,開発計画は明らかに過度に楽観的で,必要性は不足している.
2023-s-0498.impactJa: このレポートは,台湾におけるZone expropriation abuseの長期問題について証明するために,空間の割合や取引データなどのデータと統計を初めて利用したものです.個々のケースのみを調査した以前の報告とは異なり,このレポートは,多くの国内土地利用学者のフィードバックを受けたZone expropriationのシステム上の問題を強調するために,包括的なデータ分析を使用しています.

2023-s-0499.summary: La investigación sobre los reales decretos de los Gobiernos en España hecha en 2022 en Maldita.es ha mirado al pasado para traer la información al presente. Hemos creado una base de datos acumulando la información de todos los decretos aprobados por los Gobiernos de nuestra democracia. Así hemos podido descubrir y revelar que este año el actual presidente del Gobierno ha superado al resto en número de decretos aprobados, una herramienta legislativa bastante criticada por su poco control por parte de la oposición. También hemos podido comprobar y revelar que normalmente los cambios que propone la oposición no se aprueban.
2023-s-0499.impact: La labor de periodismo de datos de Maldita.es se emplea para fiscalizar a nuestros Gobiernos y representantes públicos. Este 2022 creamos nuestra propia base de datos sobre los decretos leyes aprobados por los Gobiernos de la democracia. Esta herramienta legislativa permite a los Gobiernos estar menos fiscalizados por el Congreso. Gracias a esa base de datos y a su análisis pudimos explicar que el actual presidente ya ha utilizado más los decretos que sus predecesores o que la mayoría de veces que el Congreso pide que esos decretos sean modificados para poder introducir algún cambio esto no acaba sucediendo. Del abuso de esta figura se ha hablado bastante en España, pero nunca se había hecho un análisis a ese nivel histórico y de detalle. Además, publicamos nuestra base de datos en abierto, como hacemos en multitud de ocasiones. El impacto fue importante a nivel de audiencia, pero también a nivel político y social. Publicamos también una información donde detallabamos qué partidos eran los que más habían apoyado esos decretos del Gobierno y cuáles los que menos. Algunos de los que más nos contactaron quejándose de nuestra información, como si los datos pudieran engañar. Su argumento venía a ser: 'hemos apoyado mucho los decretos, pero otras cosas no tanto'.
2023-s-0499.tools: Scraping, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, CSV
2023-s-0499.authors: Rubén Díaz Grano de Oro, Sergio Sangiao Pérez
2023-s-0499.summaryJa: メディアは過去を振り返って,現在の情報をもたらしました私たちは民主主義の政府によって承認されたすべての令状の情報を集めたデータベースを作成しました反対派による規制が少ないため,かなり批判された立法手段である.反対派が提案する変更は通常は承認されないことを確認し,明らかにしました.
2023-s-0499.impactJa: Maldita.esのデータジャーナリズムの仕事は,政府や公衆代表を監査するために使われています.2022年に民主主義政府によって承認された法律の法令に関する独自のデータベースを作成します.この立法ツールにより,議会によって政府が監査されることが少なくなります. このデータベースと分析のおかげで,現在の大統領は,前任よりも多くの法令を利用していることが説明され,あるいは議会が,その法令を変更するよう要求するほとんどの場合,それは,結局起こらない.この数字の濫用についてはスペインではよく話されていますが,歴史的なレベルでの詳細な分析は一度も行われませんでした. また,多くの場合のように,私たちは公開データベースを公開しました. 影響は聴衆レベルでも重要でしたが,政治・社会レベルでも重要でした. また,どの政党が政府の命令を最も支持し,どの政党が最も支持しなかったかを詳細に掲載した情報も公開しました. 最も連絡を受けた何人かは,データに騙されるように,私たちの情報について文句を言って,私たちに連絡しました. 議論は"我々は法令を強く支持したが,他のことはそれほど支持していない"

2023-s-0500.summary: Fazendo uso de scrollytelling, o Público olhou para os funcionários públicos em Portugal para fazer uma radiografia aos trabalhadores do estado. Quantos são? Quanto representam face ao total de trabalhadores do país. E como se compara Portugal com os outros países europeus?
2023-s-0500.impact: O trabalho foi muito bem recebido porque ajudou a contrariar muitos dos mitos que ainda existem na sociedade portuguesa face aos funcionários do estado, permitindo ainda criar uma base de informação trabalhada sobre várias áreas da função pública - e, claro, comparar Portugal com os restantes países europeus.
2023-s-0500.authors: Rui Barros, José Alves, Raquel Martins, José Volta e Pinto
2023-s-0500.summaryJa: 公共の機関がポルトガルの公務員を調査し,国営労働者をX線画像に撮った. 国の労働人口に比べて,その数はどれくらいですか. 国の労働人口に比べて,ポルトガルは他のヨーロッパ諸国とどのように比較していますか?
2023-s-0500.impactJa: この研究は,ポルトガル社会においてまだ存在している多くのミスを,公務員に対して,反省し,また,様々な公共職務分野に関する情報基盤を構築し,もちろんポルトガルを他のヨーロッパ諸国と比較させることに役立ちました.

2023-s-0501.summary: Parte de um trabalho maior de jornalismo de dados que todos os anos o Público faz - os Rankings das Escolas - este ano obtivemos uma base de dados devidamente anonimizada que continha todas as notas internas dos alunos do ensino secundário em Portugal. Para além disso, a base de dados continha alguma meta informação, nomeadamente o nome da escola, o género e se recebia alguma forma de apoio social. Analisando esta base de dados com milhares de entradas, descobrimos que algumas regiões do país são muito mais eficientes a reduzir as diferenças sociais do que outras.
2023-s-0501.impact: O trabalho voltou a evidenciar que, em Portugal, a escola pública ainda não foi capaz de mitigar as diferenças sociais - os alunos com apoio social têm resultados médios meio valor abaixo dos seus colegas sem apoios. Mas mostrar que algumas regiões do país conseguem diminuir mais essa diferença do que outras permitiu-nos ir ao terreno para tentar perceber o que se está a fazer de diferente nesses locais.
2023-s-0501.summaryJa: 年間公開される"学校ランキング"という大規模なデータジャーナリズムの一環として,この年に私たちは適切な匿名化されたデータベースを入手しましたポートリュウズの高校生の内部の成績をすべて記録しましたさらに,データベースには学校名,性別,何らかの社会支援が与えられているかどうかなど,いくつかの目的の情報が含まれていました. 数千ものデータデータベースを分析すると国の一部地域は他の地域よりも社会的な差異を減らすのにより効率的なことがわかりました
2023-s-0501.impactJa: また研究はポルトガルでは公立学校が社会的な差異を緩和できていないことを再び示しました社会支援を受けた生徒は支援のない同級生よりも平均成績が半分低いのですしかし,国の一部地域が他の地域よりもこの差異を軽減することができると示し, 現場に立ち,何が違うのか理解しようとしました

2023-s-0502.summary: An interactive data visualization piece of 173 maps and 63 charts that present the country's health infrastructure (hospital, hospital beds, number of doctors) at a microregional level for each of the 41 counties. Also, for each county, there is a visual history of the evolution of the main causes of death in the past 30 years. Ischemic heart disease remains the main cause of death due to the lack of prophylaxis.
2023-s-0502.impact: Mapping out Romania's healthcare system is crucial as it provides a clear understanding of the country's healthcare services and their organization. This project had a significant impact on the public as it allowed them to visualize the current state of the health infrastructure and identify patterns in the health of Romanians, including the main causes of death. The project's data visualization approach also made it a valuable tool for various practitioners and healthcare institutions to use for planning and decision-making.
2023-s-0502.tools: Scraping, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Tableau Public, Datawrapper, Flourish.studio, Affinity Designer
2023-s-0502.summaryJa: 互動データ可視化図 173 マップと 63 図で 41 郡の各州にマイクロ地域レベルでの国の医療インフラ (病院,病院ベッド,医師の数) を提示していますまた,各郡に過去 30 年間における主な死因の進化の視覚的な歴史があります.
2023-s-0502.impactJa: このプロジェクトは,国民に重要な影響を与え,現在の医療インフラストラクチャの状況を視覚化し,主要な死亡原因を含むロマニア人の健康のパターンを特定することが可能になった. プロジェクトのデータビジュアライゼーションアプローチは,様々な医師や医療機関が計画と意思決定に使用する貴重なツールとなりました.

2023-s-0503.summary: This work shows the alarming condition of small lakes in Jakarta. In this project, several data visualizations are also presented that show the condition of small lakes that have been turned into land, reduced, and not mapped on the Google Maps, as a largest maps platform-which is widely used as a reference in order to public policy decision by the government. In fact, the existence of small lakes is important for environmental sustainability and natural disaster mitigation. This work is solely aimed at millennial and generation z audiences, so it is combined with podcast coverage.
2023-s-0503.tools: Personalisation, QGIS, Json, Google Sheets, CSV, OpenStreetMap
2023-s-0503.summaryJa: この研究はジャカルタの小さな湖の驚くべき状態を示していますこのプロジェクトでは,いくつかのデータ可視化も示されています. このプロジェクトは,Googleマップで地図化されていない小さな湖の状態を示しています. これは政府による公共政策決定の参考として広く使用されています. 実際,小さな湖の存在は環境持続可能性と自然災害緩和にとって重要です. この作品はミレニアムや世代Zの視聴者にのみ向けられているのでポッドキャストのカバーも併用しています

2023-s-0504.summary: Mais de 90% dos empréstimos à habitação das famílias portuguesas estão indexados às taxas Euribor. As subidas das taxas de juro agravaram a situação financeira dos portugueses e muitos portugueses tiveram de fazer contas à vida para saber quanto é que a sua prestação ia subir. Nós criámos a ferramenta que permite aos leitores simular quanto vão pagar a mais com a subida da Euribor.
2023-s-0504.impact: O projecto é actualizado diariamente com os novos valores da Euribor. Desta forma, o trabalho recebe várias visitas ao longo do mês. Tem servido também para fazer algumas simulações de casos hipotéticos para perceber o impacto em algumas famílias do aumento das taxas de juro.
2023-s-0504.tools: Personalisation, D3.js, Three.js, Json, CSV, R, RStudio
2023-s-0504.summaryJa: ポーチガル人の家庭の住宅ローンの90%以上がユーロボールの利率に指数されています利率上昇はポルトガルの財政状況を悪化させ多くのポルトガルは利息がどのくらい上昇するかを知るために生活を計算しなければならなかったのです私たちは読者にユーロボールの上昇によって多額の支払いを模倣できるツールを開発しました
2023-s-0504.impactJa: プロジェクトは日々新しいEuribor値で更新され,そのため,その作品は1ヶ月間に何度も訪問される.また,利率上昇が一部の家庭に与える影響を認識するために,仮設事例を模擬するために役立つ.

2023-s-0505.summary: 15 de Novembro de 2022 foi a data projectada pela ONU como o dia em que a população mundial ultrapassou a marca dos 8 mil milhões de pessoas. Neste trabalho procuramos colocar este número em perspectiva e explicar aos nossos leitores o que ele significa, como tem evoluído a população mundial, como ela vai mudar e que desafios isso nos coloca para o futuro.
2023-s-0505.impact: O projecto teve um forte impacto junto dos nossos leitores. Pelo feedback que recebemos, o projecto foi utilizado em contexto de sala de aula com alguns alunos, demonstrando que este trabalho ajuda também a criar uma ligação com a História do planeta e dos humanos. É também um projecto desenhado para ser evergreen, onde a capacidade de contar o percurso até aos 8 mil milhões de pessoas será útil e informativa em vários momentos futuros.
2023-s-0505.tools: Animation, Personalisation, D3.js, Json, R, RStudio
2023-s-0505.authors: Rui Barros, Cátia Mendonça, José Volta e Pinto
2023-s-0505.summaryJa: 2022年11月15日は国連が予測した世界の人口が8億人を超えた日ですこの論文ではこの数字を視点で捉え読者に意味を伝え世界の人口がどのように進化し変化し未来にどんな課題を抱えているのか説明します
2023-s-0505.impactJa: このプロジェクトは読者の間で大きな影響を受けました返信からこのプロジェクトは生徒数人と教室の文脈で利用されこの研究は地球と人間の歴史とのつながりを築くのに役立つことを示しました緑の未来を図るプロジェクトです未来に800億人の人の方程を伝える能力が役に立つことも情報提供できるでしょう

2023-s-0506.summary: An interactive data story about the Romanian educational system over the past 12 years. This story focuses on the various reforms and changes that have occurred in the education system during this time period, and how they have impacted the performance of students. The innovation in this particular story is the 3 granular maps representing school-level exam results in 2 Romanian counties and the capital city.
2023-s-0506.impact: The micro level representation maps of Iasi, Cluj, and Bucharest had a significant impact on how people in Romania understand exam results. Both children and parents were drawn to viewing the results for each school, as it was the first time such maps were created in Romania on this topic
2023-s-0506.tools: Scraping, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Python, Tableau Public, Flourish.studio, Affinity Designer
2023-s-0506.summaryJa: この物語は,この期間中に教育システムに起こった様々な改革や変化,そしてどのように生徒の成績に影響を与えたかを中心にしています.この特定の物語の革新は,ルーマニアの2つの郡と首都都市における学校レベルの試験結果を代表する3つの粒子の地図です.
2023-s-0506.impactJa: 試験結果を理解するルマニア人の印象に大きく影響を与えた.子供と親は,このテーマで初めて,ルマニアでこのような地図が作成されたため,各学校の結果を眺めるよう惹かれました.

2023-s-0507.summary: We analyzed discussions on the Russo-Ukrainian War and found that the Ukrainian government is actively creating a image of defending the country on social media, while the United States has also become a global accountability target. In Taiwan, discussions were divided into two major positions, depending on the United States and suspecting the United States.
2023-s-0507.impact: In the early stages of the Russo-Ukrainian War, Taiwan became one of the global Twitter discussion focuses. Just like Ukraine, Taiwan are also a neighboring country of a great power, and the great power is keeping a close eye on us. When we analyze these social post data in different social community, whether on Facebook or Twitter, it also helps us and every Taiwan readers to re-examine Taiwan's internal consensus before facing external threats, and the parts that have not yet reached consensus. These will be very important for Taiwan as a whole in the future.
2023-s-0507.authors: Chen Pei-Yu, Syu Siang-Yun, Wu Man-Ru
2023-s-0507.summaryJa: ロシア・ウクライナ戦争に関する議論を分析し,ウクライナ政府はソーシャルメディアで国を擁護するイメージを積極的に作り上げていることがわかりました.一方で,米国はグローバルな説明責任の標的となりつつあります.台湾では,議論はアメリカとアメリカを疑うことが2つの主要立場に分かれました.
2023-s-0507.impactJa: ウクライナとロシアとの戦争初期には台湾が世界のツイッター話題の1つになりました.ウクライナと同様に台湾も大国隣国であり,大国は我々を監視しています. フェイスブックやツイッターなどでソーシャルメディアの異なるコミュニティで投稿されたデータを分析すると台湾の内部合意を外部の脅威に直面する前に再考し合意に達していない部分も台湾全体にとって重要なものになるのです

2023-s-0508.summary: In Romania, the fear of failure is a prevalent issue in the entrepreneurship landscape, with many individuals being hesitant to start their own business ventures. Research has shown that this fear is often greater among women than men. The aim of the project was to uncover the underlying reasons and explanations for why women may be more susceptible to this fear and how it affects their participation in the entrepreneurial field. The story breaks down the subject matter, analyzing various factors .
2023-s-0508.impact: The topic generated a high level of interest and the use of data visualizations to explain it was widely disseminated.
2023-s-0508.tools: Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Affinity Designer
2023-s-0508.summaryJa: ルーマニアでは,失敗の恐れは起業家精神の風景に広がり,多くの個人が自社の事業を始めるのを躊躇している.研究によると,この恐れは男性よりも女性の中でしばしば大きい. 物語は様々な要因を分析してテーマを分解します
2023-s-0508.impactJa: 話題は高度な関心を生み出し,データを視覚化して説明することが広く普及しました.

2023-s-0509.summary: Since Xi Jinping came to power, he has emphasized the "national rejuvenation and Chinese dream", adopting a tough approach towards Taiwan, actively expanding international influence through cultural, economic and social media campaigns. However, in recent years, China's international image has been negatively impacted due to the COVID-19 pandemic and debt crisis in Belt and Road countries. China has responded by increasing its presence on social media and using nationalism rhetoric to reduce internal governance conflicts.
2023-s-0509.impact: Faced with the threat of China, Taiwan must take a close look at every step and every move made by China. Through this report, we analyze China's international power deployment from the perspectives of economy, culture, and information warfare over the past decade. We see China's attempt to gain a foothold in the international arena through its economic advantages, as well as its use of these advantages to spread its culture to other countries. However, as the report also shows, these strategic infiltrations are gradually being recognized and guarded against by other countries. Meanwhile, information warfare is also on the rise. This is what Taiwan needs to pay attention to, not simply to view China's advantages pessimistically, but also to be cautious about China's next moves, especially in terms of awareness and information.
2023-s-0509.authors: Syu Siang-Yun, Wu Man-Ru, LI Fa-Hsien
2023-s-0509.summaryJa: 習近平が政権に就いた以来,台湾に対して厳しいアプローチをとり,文化,経済,ソーシャルメディアのキャンペーンを通じて国際的影響力を積極的に拡大し, "国民復興と中国の夢"を強調してきた.しかし,近年,中国の国際イメージは,ベルト・アンド・ロード諸国におけるCOVID-19流行と債務危機により負面に影響されている. 中国はソーシャルメディアで存在し,国内統治紛争を減らすために民族主義的言説を使用することで対応している.
2023-s-0509.impactJa: 中国の脅威に直面した台湾は,中国のあらゆる歩みや動きをよく観察しなければならない.このレポートを通じて,我々は過去10年間の経済,文化,情報戦争という観点から中国の国際力展開を分析する.我々は中国の経済的優位性やその利用を他の国々に文化を広めるために利用する. しかし,この報告書はまた,これらの戦略的侵入が徐々に他の国によって認識され,保護されていることを示しています.その間に情報戦争も増加しています.これは台湾が中国の優位性を悲観的に見るだけでなく,特に知覚と情報に関して,中国の次の動きに対して慎重であるために注意を払う必要があることです.

2023-s-0510.summary: We know Australia is one of the most multicultural countries in the world; more than half the population were born overseas or have a parent who was. But we wanted to let our audiences explore their own neighbourhoods specifically to understand this rich diversity: What countries do people come from? What languages do they speak? What religions do they follow? Three interactives were built using data released in 2022 from the 2021 Australian Census and delivered with an article giving extra context and the voices of the people behind the data. Not familiar with Australia? Try searching for Harris Park.
2023-s-0510.impact: This was the most-read article of the month across the SBS News website and app and in the top 10 most-read articles of the year. The story also received positive feedback from readers and was shared by Australia's leading multicultural organisation.

2023-s-0512.summary: The notion that the United States is a gerontocracy is now a reality that stands to hinder its progress and prospects, as reported in “Red, White, and Gray.” Insider journalists spent four months collectively interviewing hundreds of sources and analyzing gigabytes of data to understand how we arrived at this moment. The 30-part series explores the costs, benefits, and dangers of life in a democracy helmed by those of advanced age, where issues of profound importance to the nation's youth and future — technology, civil rights, the environment — are in the hands of those whose primes have passed and priorities differ.
2023-s-0512.impact: Following the release of this package of stories, public conversation about the advancing age of Congress began in earnest. Our first story, about the data underlying our project, received 5 million impressions on social media and 149,000 engagements. Furthermore, our polling and reporting for the first time articulated public tolerance for legislation to address the issue, and was the first to indicate robust, bipartisan and intergenerational dissatisfaction with the current system. This project sought to address a new and unexpected shift in American politics, where the representatives in Congress, judges of federal courts, and the presidency itself have come to be uniquely dominated by older generations over the past thirty years. This is abnormal and a significant deviation from the overall trend of the twentieth century. Indeed, we found the percentage of Congress that is a septuagenarian or older has reached 23% of the body, which is substantially higher than the 4% to 10% range seen throughout the twentieth century. Given the zero-sum nature of elected office, this has been catastrophic for representation across age demographics within Congress: while half of Americans are aged 38 or younger, just 4% of Congress is, an abnormally low amount historically. This has had reverberations across public life: on issues that pertain to young voters and the possibility for younger generations to become meaningfully involved in Congress. The American people feel very strongly about it: a Morning Consult/Insider poll conducted of 2,200 Americans found bipartisan and intergenerational discontent with the aging of the body. It’s a meaningful issue with a number of systemic causes — partisan redistricting, fundraising, the ascent of small-dollar donors, the value placed on seniority in the system and more — that we were able to report on throughout the series.

2023-s-0512.summaryJa: 紅白グレー誌に報告されているようにアメリカはジェロントクラシーという考えは現在進歩や見通しを妨げる現実となっています内部ジャーナリストは集約して何百もの情報源をインタビューしデータを分析してこの瞬間までどうやって来たのか理解するために 4ヶ月間費やしました 30部目で紹介されているこのシリーズは,高齢者によって主導される民主主義における生活コスト,利益,危険を調査しています.
2023-s-0512.impactJa: この記事の公開後,議会の高齢化について公的な議論が始まりました私たちの最初の記事で,我々のプロジェクトを基盤としたデータについて, 5百万件のインプレッションと 149,000件のエンゲージメントが受けられました. さらに,我々の調査と報告は,この問題に対処する法律に対する公の寛容を初めて表し,現行の制度に対する強固な,両党派的,世代間的不満を最初に示した. このプロジェクトは,過去30年間,議会の代表,連邦裁判所の裁判官,大統領府自身が高齢者によって独占的に支配されているアメリカ政治における新しい,予期せぬ変化を解決しようと試みましたこれは20世紀の全体的な傾向から異常であり,大きな偏見です. 実際,議会で7歳以上の議員の割合は23%に達し,この割合は20世紀を通して見られる4%〜10%の範囲よりも大幅に高いことが判明しました.選挙のゼロサム性質を考えると,これは議会内の年齢人口統計における代表性にとって壊滅的なことでした.アメリカ人の半分が38歳以下で,議会の4%だけが,歴史的に異常な低い数です. これは公衆生活全体で反響を及ぼし,若い選挙人に関する問題や若い世代が議会に意義ある形で関与する可能性についてです.アメリカ人はこのことについて非常に強く感じている.モーニング・コンサルティング/インサイダーによる2,200人のアメリカ人を対象とした調査では,身体の老化に対する両党派と世代間の不満が明らかになった. 党派の再区分や資金調達低所得者への寄付の上昇制度上の地位に価値を置く価値などシステム上の多くの要因を挙げてきました

2023-s-0514.summary: Using a series of public records requests and expert sourcing in law enforcement and cybersecurity, NPR correspondents were able to track a mysterious hoax caller reporting false bomb threats and shootings at schools across the country. The caller, who appeared to be operating out of Ethiopia, used an internet based calling platform called Voice Over IP–a service that has serious challenges cracking down on fraud and abuse.
2023-s-0514.impact: NPR’s reporting brought together seemingly disparate data points from schools and local police departments around the country to reveal not only a disturbing trend but a specific pattern of activity that can be traced back to a single person or group of people. As a result, federal law enforcement is more deeply aware of the perpetrator’s activities, and local communities can begin linking up to share information. Local students, teachers, and parents desperately want more information about how an anonymous hoax caller can inspire very real fear and mobilize law enforcement. If we can’t yet answer why, we can begin to answer how. Following NPR’s reporting, other journalists began requesting records in their communities, and technical experts have been able to dig more deeply into the caller’s background. At least partially as a result of NPR’s reporting, one Voice Over IP service called TextNow decided to permanently ban users in Ethiopia from accessing its platform.
2023-s-0514.tools: D3.js, Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets

2023-s-0514.summaryJa: NPRの通信者は,一連の公的な記録要求と法執行とサイバーセキュリティの専門家調達を使用して,全国の学校で偽爆弾の脅威と銃撃事件を報告した謎のホックコールラーを追跡することができました.エチオピアから運営されているようで,電話をした人は,詐欺と虐待を食い止める深刻な課題を持つ Voice Over IP<unk>というインターネットベースの電話プラットフォームを使用しました.
2023-s-0514.impactJa: NPRの報告では,全国各地の学校や地方警察局から明らかに異なるデータポイントを集めて,不安な傾向だけでなく,特定の活動パターンを明らかにし,それは単一の人または集団に追溯することができます.その結果,連邦法執行機関は,犯罪者の活動についてより深く認識し,地元のコミュニティは情報を共有するためにリンクし始めることができます. 匿名で騙された電話が本当に恐怖を招く方法や法執行機関を動員できる方法について,地元の学生,教師,親たちは絶望的により多くの情報を求めています.なぜか答えられない場合は,どのように答えることができるかを始めることができます.NPRの報道の後,他のジャーナリストはコミュニティで記録を要求し,技術専門家が電話の背景をより深く掘り下げることができました. 少なくとも部分的にNPRの報道の結果, TextNowというVoice Over IPサービスがエチオピアでユーザーのプラットフォームにアクセスすることを永久に禁止することを決定しました.

2023-s-0515.summary: Taiwan bans the use of Chinese products in any public agencies. However, we discovered that the surveillance systems recently procured by Taiwan’s biggest industrial park were actually made by China-based Hikvision. We use the latest tachnique skills to track how Hikvision beat the ban.
2023-s-0515.impact: 台灣政府考量國安，過去一年限制政府機關使用中國品牌的科技產品，但我們調查發現，隸屬於經濟部管理的新竹工業園區，園區內的監視器竟是「台皮陸骨」，仍使用中國品牌。 我們首先透過政府採購公告的資訊，取得與新竹工業園區監視器同一機型的Benelink產品，另外，也購買了正品海康監視器。 接著，我們從硬體、韌體和軟體三方面來檢視，結果發現，從主機板型號、用戶介面設計、到韌體的代碼，幾乎一致。海康旗下的貼牌產品。報導出來後，新竹工業區立即下架相關產品，並重新檢視政府機關內的科技產品。

2023-s-0517.summary: Georgia lawmakers changed voting laws after the 2020 election, including eliminating drop boxes in certain counties. By compiling location and usage data - including thousands of ballot transfer forms from the 2020 election - and performing geospatial analysis, reporters found that the new law made it harder for many voters in cities and suburbs, often people of color, to access them. These are also the groups that used drop boxes most.

2023-s-0518.summary: Since the Taliban took over Afghanistan in August 2021, the country’s economic and humanitarian situation has worsened. Amid this desperation are countless stories of survival. In this story Al Jazeera spoke to seven families from across Afghanistan to tell their stories beyond the numbers.
2023-s-0518.impact: Following on from Al Jazeera’s coverage of the fall of Kabul in August 2021, for which AJ Labs won an Edward R Murrow Award for Afghanistan: Visualising the impact of 20 years of war, we followed the stories of seven families each dealing with the fallout of the Taliban takeover and crippling impact of sanctions imposed on the country. Millions of dollars in international aid have also been halted with nine in ten families across the country not getting enough to eat each day. When many other news outlets moved on, Al Jazeera continued to cover the story. Our ongoing coverage includes human data stories to help contextualise the situation on the ground. By continuously updating the story, we endeavor to continue raising awareness of the impact that 20 years of war has had on the Afghan people.

2023-s-0519.summary: During the summer of 2022, weeks of torrential rains and flash floods ravaged Pakistan killing more than 1,500 people and affecting at least 33 million more. Pakistan’s climate change minister called the extreme weather “the monster monsoon of the decade”. Following the record storms many across Pakistan were looking for answers. What caused the floods, where were the worst-affected regions, and what lessons were learned from 2010 - when similar flooding ravaged Pakistan, killing more than 1,700. Al Jazeera analysed satellite images, gathered on-the-ground testimonies and spoke with local climate experts who helped us visualise and accurately answer these questions.
2023-s-0519.impact: This immersive story broke down in great detail quantifiable ways of measuring the scale of destruction. This project was also one of our most viewed stories about the Pakistan floods and formed a basis for all recovery stories that continued throughout the year.

2023-f-0001.summary: I am the sole reporter and I made almost all of the elements presented in the stories. Wong Siew Lyn edited all the stories. These projects investigated unsustainable use of forests in Peninsular Malaysia, and exposed systemic failures, illegal activity, or projects that hurt the state and communities but benefit the shareholders. In ‚ÄúForest Plantations in Reserves‚Äù, I showed that the governments‚Äô forest plantation efforts have destroyed huge tracts of forests without achieving delivering any goals. Forest plantations are monoculture tree farms, and were meant to provide a sustainable timber supply. But I showed that governments only approved plantations inside reserves, and that two-thirds of the 185,000 ha cleared for plantations had been abandoned. Furthermore, genuine planters are struggling with their businesses and refuse to harvest timber as scheduled. I analysed more than 40 years of forest plantation documents ‚Äì government reports, conference papers, manuals, and scientific studies. I sought maps to check if and where plantations were destroying good forests. I combed through company financial statements and EIA reports of projects. I persuaded loggers and planters to explain the specifics of their projects; got government officers to confess that their data fails to reflect reality; and spoke with communities affected by forest plantations. The work required data that is distributed without clear organisation across several government agencies. I had to go to these agencies, daily for weeks to comb their shelves. To convince loggers and planters, I spent days roaming in town. A month before my publication, the government suddenly announced a halt on new forest plantation projects. My findings were used in a debate in state legislative assembly. And in the year after publication, as forest plantations hit the news often, journalists and policymakers refer to my stories for background. For ‚ÄúCutting Chini-Bera Forests‚Ä¶‚Äù, I revealed how the state government and Department of Environment have approved an oil palm project doomed to fail. That‚Äôs because the project had and will clear natural forests, which disqualifies it from mandatory sustainability certification in Malaysia. The forests there houses tigers, elephants, and hornbills. The site also houses two indigenous villages, some of whom claim they were tricked by the developer into signing letters of consent. Digging into company documents and property ownership, I showed that the developer‚Äôs shareholder include royalty and a major Thai conglomerate that brands itself as a tiger defender in Thailand. I made accurate maps and gathered satellite images of the deforestation, and used the evidence to prod Malaysian oil palm regulators into responding: they denounced the project. After publication, the developer didn‚Äôt exercise their rights to start logging. A major conservation group suspended its partnership with the Thai conglomerate. And lawyers for the indigenous villagers are using my stories and data to build their court case. In the third project, ‚ÄúDrains Dug, Trees Cut, Now Let‚Äôs it Approved‚Äù, I exposed a developer for clearing forests and planting oil palm before it even submitted the mandatory environmental impact assessment (EIA). This was a risky story to report on because the Sultan of the state and his family own the developer and the land. The evidence and data I present must be extra solid. I extracted location, names, and dates of legal procedures out of the project‚Äôs EIA report. I used satellite images to identify progress of deforestation. Then I used a drone to snap images of the development. But the drone limited range meant I had to enter the plantations, posing as a birder, to get exact coordinates of the site‚Äôs border and see the palm saplings planted. I also spoke with workers and locals. The story prompted the Department of Environment to investigate the developer.
2023-f-0001.jury: Data journalism in Malaysia has been elevated to another level since Yao Ha-Law began to lend his talent. To show this contribution, it is important to note that the focus of the work is on environmental issues in a country that has many needs in this area. By using visuals, precision journalism, and other tools, his production gives shape and concreteness to the issues. An example of an initiative that projects Yao Ha-Law's career is the creation of the Macaranga portal, addressing issues that have not been disclosed by any other communication vehicle. By publishing mainly about forestry data, the work of the award-winning professional is exquisite. With his denunciations, often being the only voice to divulge the subject, Yao Hua-Law managed to produce effective results, preventing the continuation of environmental crimes.

2023-f-0001.juryJa: マレーシアにおけるデータジャーナリズムはヤオ・ハ・ローが才能を貸し始めた時から別のレベルに昇格している.この貢献を示すために,この分野に多くのニーズがある国の環境問題に焦点を当てていることに注意することが重要です.視覚,精度ジャーナリズム,その他のツールを使用して,彼の制作は問題に形状と具体的な性を与えます. 岩・ハ・ローのキャリアを計画するイニシアチブの一例は,他の通信機関によって明らかにされていない問題に対処するマカランガポータルの作成である.主に林業データについて掲載することで,受賞歴のある専門家の仕事は精彩である.彼の非難により,しばしばこの主題を明らかにする唯一の声であるヤオ・ハ・ローは,環境犯罪の継続を防ぐために効果的な結果を生み出せることに成功した.

2023-f-0002.summary: **Additional information from the applicant:** I've submitted seven projects as part of my portfolio. In five of them I'm credited either on the byline, or footer, or below the graphic pieces. They are: 1. Amazon Under Siege (The Intercept Brasil) - cited below graphics Contributed only with the charts and animated maps. The Intercept's team had already obtained and pre-analyzed the data. They briefed me on the discussion and invited me to come up with the visualizations. 2. Cities & the Climate (Rede Interação) - cited in footer notes Contributed with almost every facet of the project. Rede Interação had no expertise in infographics or printed publications. I was called in to both research the content, write it and edit it as well as come up with layout, composition, visualization, and illustrations. The only parts I wasn't involved in were the translations to other languages, and the workshops with local communities, which were held in person and helped shape the publication. 3. Cattle Laundering (Revista Piauí) - cited in footer notes Contributed only with static charts, header illustration, video and storytelling ideas. The video was the main piece I worked on. Piauí's team had already done most of the reporting, but had trouble coming up with an intuitive and engaging way to convey the data they obtained. I suggested a video as a storytelling device and got to work with the editors on a script, motion graphics and sound design. The reporters recorded the narration for the video, and other interesting pieces of information were visualized as static charts. 4. Yanomami under attack (Sumaúma Jornal) - cited in footer notes Contributed only with static charts, data analysis and animated maps. The Sumaúma team contacted me before visiting the Yanomami territory and asked me to come up with charts detailing the impact on Yanomami women's health. Soon after, they obtained data from local leadership and I analyzed and wrangled the data and proposed these sets of graphic pieces. 5. Deforestation in the meat business in Brazil (Repórter Brasil/Unearthed) - cited below graphics Contributed only with static charts and data analysis. The Greenpeace team was working with Repórter Brasil in following the trail of illegal cattle in the Amazon. The bulk of the data work was done by Reporter Brasil's team, which resulted in a fairly large dataset that needed some analysis in search for relevant aspects to be visualized. That's where I conducted most of my work. The other two projects don't seem to cite my name anywhere. They are: 1. The radicalization of Jovem Pan (Revista Piauí) Contributed with data analysis, static charts, video research and video editing. The team behind Novelo Data invited me to help them analyze and visualize a large dataset for Revista Piauí. They managed to scrape from YouTube the transcriptions for every episode of Pingos Nos Is, which is Jovem Pan's most prestiged news show and, with so much data available, had a hard time coming up with insights from it and finding ways to visualize it. I proposed some analysis questions, and got to working with the data. This project was a part of a larger investigation conducted by Revista Piauí on Jovem Pan's history, with which I had no involvement. The reporting team occasionally requested some topics to be explored on the data side, and I worked on it alongside Novelo's team. I developed some interactive charts as well which didn't end up on the final piece due to CMS limitations. Midway through the work we had the idea of producing a video montage. I then sketched out a script with the general ideas, and partially watched 100+ episodes of Pingos Nos Is in search of footage. My involvement with the project can be corroborated by Guilherme Felitti (guilherme@novelo.io), Novelo Data's founder, and main data scientist on this piece. 2. The Connection (Revista Piauí) Contributed only with illustrations, static and animated maps and charts. The reporting was already well advanced with Piauí and OCCRP teams following the trail of yellow Ipê. They had obtained a large amount of geographical and transactional data and needed to present it in a compelling way. I went through their dataset trying to reconstruct the routes and visualize them in maps. My involvement with the project can be corroborated by Allan de Abreu (allandeabreu@revistapiaui.com.br), the main reporter for this piece. **The original project details are as follows:** Amazon Under Siege (The Intercept Brasil) This feature examines the rise in the numbers of shooting clubs in the Amazon and their effects on the neighbouring indigenous lands and other vulnerable communities. For this project, I worked to visualize the original data obtained by The Intercept team in engaging ways, and used static and animated maps and charts. This project was specially important in the context of the 2022 brazilian elections. Cities & the Climate (Rede Interação) This large-scale infographic was comissioned by the NGO Rede Interação and produced with input from the communities of Santarém, Pará. It illustrates how urban life relates to climate change and many of the feedback loops involved in these interactions. I was responsible for research, writing, designing, mapping and illustrating the piece. It was distributed freely at Amazon cities and online, in three languages, and informed citizens of the north region of Brazil. Cattle Laundering (Revista Piauí) Part of a larger investigative initiative made in collaboration with OCCRP, CCCA and Fiquem Sabendo, this piece for Piauí details how cattle laundering works in the Amazon and how ingrained it is in the meat business in Brazil. I produced static charts and maps and an animated video detailing the process and it's effects. This project shed a light on a repeating pattern on the region. The radicalization of Jovem Pan (Revista Piauí) This visual analysis produced for Piauí with Novelo Data's team illustrates how one of Brazil's biggest TV outlets became a disseminator of Bolsonaro's ideology. For this piece I watched hundreds of programs to piece together a video montage detailing how the channel's positioning changed over time and how it fit with Bolsonaro's agenda. I also produced static charts with data processed by Novelo Data's team from YouTube transcriptions. The Connection (Revista Piauí) In this piece, I collaborated with charts, illustrations, and maps reporters which reconstructed the route of a batch of yellow ipê wood illegally extracted from the Brazilian state of Pará to a store in New York. Made in collaboration with OCCRP and CCCA, the piece revealed a series of irregularities and corrupt practices along the route that helped to “launder” the endangered wood. The movement of the ipê batch also raised suspicions among Brazilian customs officials, but a series of decisions by the then-Minister of the Environment undermined any chance of investigating the sale. That same minister had already faced scrutiny by the Federal Police for facilitating the international smuggling of timber from the Amazon. Shortly thereafter, he resigned. Yanomami under attack (Sumaúma Jornal) The Yanomami land is the largest indigenous territory in Brazil and also one of the main targets of illegal miners bringing violence and destruction to the region. Sumaúma obtained data on these impacts and visited the territory in loco, providing me with first-hand reporting on the situation, and images which helped me produce the animated and static maps and charts in the piece. Deforestation in the meat business in Brazil (Repórter Brasil/Unearthed) This collaborative investigation from Unearthed, Greenpeace and Repórter Brasil revealed how Brazil's biggest meat company bought almost 9,000 cattle from one of the biggest deforesters in the country, leading the company to admit, for the first time in its history, to malfeasance. I collaborated with maps, charts and data analysis.
2023-f-0002.summaryJa: ** 申請者からの追加情報:** 私は7つのプロジェクトを私のポートフォリオの一部として提出しました.そのうちの5つには,私はバイライン,またはフーター,またはグラフィックピースにクレジットされています. プロジェクトのほぼすべての側面に貢献した. ネットワーク・インタラクションはインフォグラフィックや印刷出版の専門知識を持っていなかった. 私はコンテンツを研究し,書き直し編集し,レイアウト,作曲,ビジュアル化,イラストレーションの両方をするために呼ばれた. 出版を形作る手助けをしたのは,他の言語への翻訳と地元のコミュニティとのワークショップでした. Piauíのチームは既にほとんどのレポートを完成しましたが,入手したデータを伝える直感的で魅力的な方法に困った. 私はビデオをストーリーテリングデバイスとして提案し,脚本,モーショングラフィック,サウンドデザインの編集者と作業を始めました. 記者たちはビデオの物語を記録し,他の興味深い情報の一部を静态チャートとして視覚化しました. ユナマミ・アタック (Sumaumauma Jornal) - footnotes 付与する静態チャート,データ分析,アニメーションマップのみ. ユナマミ・アタック (Sumaumauma Jornal) チームは,ユナマミ・アタック (Yanaomami Jornal) を訪問する前に私に連絡し,ユナマミ・アタック (Yanaomami Jornal) の健康への影響を詳細に説明するチャートを作成するよう頼みました. グラフィックは静態チャートとデータ分析のみに貢献しています. グリーンピースチームは,アマゾンにおける違法牛の追跡について,Reporter Brasilと連携していた. データ作業のほとんどは,Reporter Brasilのチームによって行われた. ニュー・パンの過激化 (Jovem Pan Magazine) データの分析,静態チャート,ビデオ研究,ビデオ編集による貢献. Novelo Dataの背後にあるチームは,私に,ニュー・パンの大規模なデータセットを分析し,視覚化するのに役立つよう誘われました. 彼らはユートブからPingos Nos IsのすべてのエピソードのトランスクリプションをスクrapeすることができましたこれはJovem Panの最も権威あるニュース番組であり,データがたくさん利用可能で,それからの洞察を得てそれを視覚化する方法を見つけることが困難でした. 私はいくつかの分析質問を提案し,データと作業しました. このプロジェクトはJovem Panの歴史に関するより大きな調査の一部でした. 報告チームは時々データサイドで探査する話題を依頼し,私はノヴェロのチームと一緒に作業しました. 私はまたCMSの制限により最終作品に終わらなかったインタラクティブなチャートを開発しました. 作業の途中で私たちはビデオ montageを制作するというアイデアを思いつきました. 私はその後,一般的なアイデアを備えた脚本をスケッチし,部分的に100+エピソードのPingos Nos Is in search of footageを見ました. このプロジェクトへの私の関与は, Novelo Data's founder, and main data scientist on this piece (guilherme@novelo.io) によって確認される. 彼らは大きな量の地理的および取引データを得て説得力のある方法で提示する必要がありました私は彼らのデータセットを介して路線を再構築し,地図でそれらを視覚化しようとしましたこのプロジェクトへの私の関与は,この作品の主な記者である Allan de Abreu (allandeabreu@revistapiaui.com.br) によって確認できます **オリジナルプロジェクト詳細は以下の通りです:** Amazon Under Siege (The Intercept Brasil) この機能はアマゾンにおける射撃クラブの数の増加と隣接する原住民土地および他の脆弱なコミュニティへの影響を調査しています. このプロジェクトのために,私はThe Interceptチームによって集まる方法で入手されたオリジナルデータを視覚化するために働き,静態とアニメーションの地図とチャートを使用しました. この大規模なインフォグラフィックはNGOネットワークインタラクションによって委託され,サンタレム,パラのコミュニティからのインプットで制作されました. 都市生活が気候変動とどのように関係しているか,そしてこれらの相互作用に関与する多くのフィードバックループを説明します. 私は研究,執筆,デザイン,マッピング,そして作品のイラストを担当しました. ブラジル北部の市民を情報に導くために,Amazon cities and onlineで自由に配布されました. Cattle Laundering (Piauí雑誌) はOCCRP,CCCA,Fiquem Sabendoと協力して行われた大規模な調査の一部です. このプロジェクトでは,この地域における繰り返しのパターンに光を当てました.Jovem Panの過激化 (Piauí雑誌) このPiauíとNovelo Dataのチームで制作されたビジュアル分析は,ブラジルの最大のテレビ局の一つがボルソナロのイデオロギーの拡散者になったことを説明します. この作品のために私は何百もの番組を視聴しチャンネルの位置が時間とともにどのように変化しボルソナロの計画にどのように適合するかについてのビデオを集めた. また,YouTubeのトランスクリプションからノベロ・データチームによって処理されたデータを持つ静態チャートも制作しましたこの作品では,ブラジル州パラから違法に採取された黄色のイペ木の一批の路線を再構築したチャート,イラスト,マップの記者と協力しました. OCCRPとCCCCAと協力して制作されたこの作品では,路線に沿って不規則性や腐敗の一連の行為が明らかになりました. この動きはブラジル海关当局者にも疑いを引き上げましたが,当時の環境大臣の一連の決定は,売却を調査する機会を損なっていました. その同じ大臣は,アマゾンから木材の国際密輸を容易にするという連邦警察による審査に直面していた. <unk>野馬は,この地域への暴力と破壊をもたらす違法鉱山業者の主要な標的の一つであり,この地域への暴力と破壊を最大限に抑える本土土です. ブラジルにおける肉業における森林破壊 (Reporter Brasil/Unearthed) この共同調査で,Unearthed,Greenpeace,Reporter Brasilはブラジルの最大の肉業会社が,最大の森林破壊者の一つから,ほぼ9,000頭の牛を購入したことを明らかにし,その会社を初めて,悪行を認めるよう促しました.

2023-f-0003.summary: My portfolio submission shows my work on the Russia-Ukraine war and its consequences. The goal is to show some of the breadth of what I’ve produced on the subject in the past year. In addition to stories about how the war affects Ukraine and the rest of the world, I’ve tried to include stories of how the war is changing Russia. I’ve also included an article suggesting how hard it is to cover the country as a data journalist - providing statistical evidence that within it, even covid death statistics may have been actively faked. To usefully highlight some challenges I encountered along the way: “Russians in every major city and region call for #nowar” includes data from public profiles on Instagram. Instagram does not provide this to journalists, and have taken steps to make obtaining it via computer very difficult. Getting this data was therefore very, very, time-consuming. “Russia is swaying Twitter users outside the West to its side” uses a machine learning algorithm to detect pro-Ukraine, neutral, and pro-Russia sentiment. Such an algorithm did not exist when I started the project, so I had to make and validate one myself. This involved manually reading and coding thousands of tweets to create training data. “Vladimir Putin is dragging the world back to a bloodier time” begins with a map showing the approximate location of all wars on the planet since 1816. No dataset of these locations existed either - so I had to find them through other data and historical research. In terms of metrics, I am not sure what is expected or what I’m allowed to say on my end. However, I can confidently say that all these articles were widely read: and some were among the most popular articles we have published all year. Moreover, the article “Costly food and energy are fostering global unrest” resulted in massive policy engagement. This included “a high-level discussion” at the United Nations’ headquarters (they told me I could not be more specific), which centred on how the UN could use the methods it pioneered in its work and planning. I am the author of all these projects, doing the data collection, modelling, writing, and reporting. All were solo-authored except three: Daniella Raz collaborated with me on "How the war in Ukraine compares to other refugee crises", Adam Roberts on “Vladimir Putin is dragging the world back to a bloodier time”, and “Costly food and energy are fostering global unrest” was the work of many hands - I did the data journalism sections, and Robert Guest, Joanna Lillis, Charlotte McCann, Lena Schipper, Mitra Taj, Liam Taylor, Namini Wijedasa, Piotr Zalewski contributed the rest. I gratefully acknowledge the support of the wider editorial staff, especially my editors and talented data visualizers and interactive designers.
2023-f-0003.summaryJa: 私のポートフォリオの投稿は,ロシア-ウクライナ戦争とその結果に関する私の作業を示しています.目標は,この問題について過去1年間で私が制作した作品の幅の一部を示すことです.戦争がウクライナと世界全体に影響を与える物語に加えて,戦争がロシアをどのように変化させているかについての物語を含もうと試みました. データのジャーナリストとして国をカバーするのはどれほど難しいか示す記事を掲載しました. この記事では,COVIDによる死亡統計も積極的に偽造された可能性があるという統計的な証拠を提示しています. 途中に出会ったいくつかの課題を参考にするために,すべての主要都市や地域のロシア人が #nowarを呼びかけている. メディアは,この情報をインターネット上で入手し,それをコンピュータで入手することは非常に困難なものにするために,インスタグラムが措置をとっています.このデータを取得することは非常に,非常に,時間耗費です. <unk>ロシアは西洋以外のTwitterユーザーを自分の側に押し付けています<unk> ウクライナ支持,中立,ロシア支持の感情を検出するために機械学習アルゴリズムを使用しています. 訓練データを作成するために数千のツイートを手動で読み込み,コード化することが必要でした. <unk>プーチン大統領は世界を血の<unk>の時間へと引き戻しています. 1816年以降の地球上のすべての戦争がほぼどこにあったかを示す地図から始まります.これらの場所のデータセットも存在しませんでした.それ故私は他のデータや歴史的研究を通じてそれらを見つけなければなりませんでした. メトリックの観点から,私は何を期待するか,私の端で何を言わせるかわからない. しかし,この記事はすべて広く読まれていたと確信を持って言える.そして,そのいくつかは私たちが全年出版した最も人気のある記事でした.さらに,記事"高価な食料とエネルギーが世界的な不安を助長している"は,大規模な政策関与をもたらしました.この記事には国連本部での"高いレベルの議論"も含まれていました (私はより具体的に説明できないと言われた) 国連がその作業と計画において先駆的な方法を使用する方法に焦点を当てました. 私はこれらのプロジェクトを作っていますデータ収集やモデリング,執筆,レポートをします 3つを除いては全て独作作でした:ダニエラ・ラズが"ウクライナでの戦争が他の難民危機と比較する方法"で私と協力し,アダム・ロバートスが"プーチンが世界を血の<unk>に引き戻している"で,そして"高価な食料とエネルギーが世界的な不安を助長している"は,多くの人の作品でした - 私はデータジャーナリズム部門を担当し,ロバート・ゲスト,ジョアンナ・リリス,シャーロット・マッカン,レーナ・シッパー,ミトラ・タージ,リアム・テイラー,ナミニ・ウィジェダサ,ピオトル・ザレフスキーは残りを担当しました. 編集部や才能あるデータビジュアライザーやインタラクティブデザイナーなど幅広い編集部の支援に感謝しています

2023-f-0004.summary: 在傳統雜誌發展數位優先、且data-driven、visual journalism的報導，最大的挑戰是，要去證明新興的報導手法和呈現方式，和傳統特寫報導（feature writing）一樣有深度、甚至更能回應讀者的閱讀場景和需求。 在我們提交的作品集中，可以看到我們不僅有處理即時新聞的能量，例如「最新台灣疫情關鍵數字」、「烏俄戰爭的即時戰況數據」、「台灣2022年地方選舉暨修憲公投」、「解放軍24小時環台軍演」，也兼具長篇報導、調查報導，例如「人民日報十年頭版解讀」、「躲不掉的中國天眼」。 同時，考量到有超過八成的讀者是透過行動裝置來閱讀報導，在作品集中，也能看到我們特別針對行動裝置的UI/UX設計，讓讀者不管是透過桌機或行動裝置，都能與我們的視覺化、或大量的資料集（datasets）進行探索和互動。

2023-f-0005.summary: The Innovation Lab's portfolio primarily includes dataviz and visual stories on various topics – from interactive calculators to scrollytelling to live graphics. A quick overview on the stories we handed in: For our YouTube and dataviz series „Papaya and Fries“, which was about migrant kitchen and climate change, we built an interactive climate impact calculator for cooking. This can be used to calculate exactly how much CO2 a dish consumes. The data comes from the API of the startup Eaternity, which deals with CO2 balancing. An animated scrollytelling with the most important foodstuff furthermore made possible to quickly compare the values and understand, why for example chicken can be much more climatefriendly than many vegetarian aliments made from milk – or, why vegan produce will always be more climate friendly, even if imported. In our live article on the Ukraine war, the map shows the course of the war, most current research by media all over the world as well as the locations of significant fighting and tropu movements. It is updated daily. Other graphics in the article data such as support payments to Ukraine, refugees and air strikes. Per month the article gets an average of more than 500.000 clicks. It is among the most successful published pieces. The war in Ukraine showed in sad clarity how dependent Germany is on Russian gas. The Tagesspiegel Innovation Lab has therefore built a gas simulator in exchange with scientists, where everyone can try out for themselves how different measures and decisions could interact when the discussion about them was most vibrant last summer. Because fake videos are used for disinformation in the Ukraine war, we show how easy it is to make such videos with our own Deep fake. And where the limitations are. The „Temperature Monitor„ is also a live graphic and is intended to give a rough impression of how "normal" the weather is right now. Daily weather data and forecasts come directly from German Weather Service APIs. With a methodologically very transparent display it shows how – over time – a dramatic climatic trend is created from weather fluctuations. The consequences of climate change could be observed especially well in the summer of 2022. In 2022, many rivers had too little water. We use graphics based on water height measurements and satellite images to show how serious the situation is. With visual formats we tell the story of the nely started oil production in Uganda from the beginning – using 3D maps; data sets and satellite images around the logistical large-scale operation and the ecological risks. Regularly, we use data to work locally and map neighborhoods - for example, with the green space map. It shows which neighborhoods have particularly poor environmental factors. Readers could explore their neighborhoods. The map was our most successful subscription piece. In addition to current topics, the Innovation Lab is part of the European Cities Investigative Journalism Accelerator, in which it leads the data management and dataviz for the whole network of 12 European media organisations. It's a network of European media dedicated to researching common challenges facing major European cities and countries. In focus so far is mainly housing. The research on Student Housing is a part of this.
2023-f-0005.summaryJa: 革新ラボのポートフォリオは主に様々なトピックに関するデータvizとビジュアルストーリーを含みますインタラクティブ・カルクレーターからスクロール・テリングからライブ・グラフィックまでです配信したストーリーの速やかな概要: YouTubeやデータvizシリーズについて <unk>パヤとフライズについてです移民料理と気候変動についてです料理のためのインタラクティブ・気候影響計算機を構築しましたこれは皿が消費するCO2を正確に計算するために使用できますスタートアップEaternityのAPIからデータを得ていますスタートアップEaternityはCO2バランスに関するものですさらに,最も重要な食品とアニメーションのスロールテリングにより, 値を迅速に比較し,なぜ例えば鶏肉は牛乳から作られた多くのベジタリアン食品よりも気候に優しいものなのかを理解することが可能になりましたウクライナ戦争に関する私たちのライブ記事では,地図は戦争の進行を示しています,世界中のメディアによる最新の調査だけでなく,重要な戦闘とトロプ運動の場所も.それは毎日更新されます.記事の他のグラフィックデータにはウクライナへの支援支払,難民と空爆などのデータがあります. 毎月記事平均で500,000以上のクリックが表示されます. ウクライナ戦争が悲しい明確さでドイツがロシアガスに依存していることを示しました Tagesspiegel Innovation Labは科学者との交換でガスシミュレーターを構築しましたそこで誰もが自分たちで試すことができます異なる措置と決定がどのように相互作用するかを温度モニターはまたライブグラフィックで,現在の気象の"正常"程度を粗略に示すように設計されています. 日々の気象データと予測はドイツ気象サービスAPIから直接来ています. 方法的に非常に透明なディスプレイで, 時間の経過とともに劇的な気候傾向が気象変動からどのように形成されるかを示しています. 特に2022年の夏に,気候変動の影響をよく観察できます. 2022年には多くの川は水分が少ない. 状況がどれほど深刻であるか示すために水位測定や衛星画像を利用しています. 視覚形式で3D地図を使ってウガンダで石油生産が始まったの話をします. 地域や地域を地図化するために定期的にデータを使用します. 例えばグリーンスペース地図で. 地域は特に環境要因が悪い地域を示しています. 読者は地域を探索することができます.地図は私たちの最も成功した購読作品でした. 現在の話題に加えて,イノベーションラボは欧州都市調査ジャーナリズム加速器の一部です. 12つのヨーロッパのメディア組織のネットワークのデータ管理とデータvizをリードしています. ヨーロッパの主要都市や国々における共通の課題を研究するネットワークです. 現在,主に住宅に焦点を当てています.

2023-f-0006.summary: The principal authors AIrstrips of Destruction are Hyury Potter, for The Intercept Brasil, Manuela Andreoni, Blacki Migliozzi, Pablo Robles, Victor Moriyama and Denise Lu, all for The New York Times, and Joseph Poliszuk, María Antonieta Segovia and María de los Ángeles Ramírez, from Armando Info/El Pais. The project was done with the coordinatination of the Pulitzer Center’s Rainforest Investigations Network editorial team: Environmental Investigations Editor: Gustavo Faleiros, Executive Editor: Marina Waker Guevara, Data Editor: Kuek Ser Kuang Keng and Reseach Editor: Jelter Meers. Partnership with Earthrise Media developers Caleb Kruse and Edward Boyda. The products of this collaboration are - 1 multimedia (front page) article published at The New York Times about airstrips in Brazil - A series of six articles called "Corredor Furtivo" with multimedia elements published simultaneously at El País and Armando Info, about the relation between the airstrips and illegal armed groups in Venezuela - 1 featured article at the Intercept Brasil about the relation between the airstrips and illegal mining in Brazil - 1 documentary launched by The Intercept about the life and work of the pilots working in the illegal runaways. - The website Amazon Mining Watch and GitHub page managed by the Earthrise Media with all the documentation and code for the geospatial analysis Since its inception, the investigation had the ambition of generating strong stories and groundbreaking data analysis that would serve as a blueprint for other journalists and civil society actors investigating criminal activities in the Amazon. From their previous reporting, Potter, Poliszuk, Ramírez and Andreoni knew that unregulated landing strips were key to the criminal infrastructure that facilitates gold mining and other illegal activities. But until now no one had been able to systematically research, identify, and map the gold mines and airstrips, in part because of the impenetrable geography of the Amazon. As Rainforest Investigations Fellows, the three journalists decided to join forces to combine advanced data analysis and technology with traditional shoe-leather reporting to reveal for the first time the true scope of the problem. The team partnered with Earthrise Media to build a machine-learning algorithm and the public database that underpins the project. The Amazon’s illegal economy is an extremely dangerous beat. To complement and verify the computational findings, our reporters did extensive field reporting and had to take many safety precautions. They talked to the people affected by illegal mining and to the pilots flying to and from the mines. They visited the different parts of the illegal mining supply chain, from dig sites to clandestine gold shops. Different parts of the analysis included painstaking manual work to improve the machine learning algorithm and verify the results. Lining up satellite imagery with a computer program also created coding problems and technical delays. The development of the algorithm consisted of manually selecting information from historical satellite imagery and then using this baseline for programs to find similar patterns in recent images. This machine-learning process allowed the team to scan thousands of high-resolution Sentinel 2 satellite images dating back to 2016, covering an enormous area in the Amazon. Such a statistical and computational model is known as an artificial neural network. It was trained to look at patches the size of 44 by 44 10-meter pixels, an equivalent of 440m by 440m on the ground. The AI program found roughly 1269 airstrips in the Brazilian Amazon and 47 in Venezuelan Amazon . Many were found by cross-referencing information in Open Street Map, a community-built global map of roads and other infrastructure.
2023-f-0006.summaryJa: 主要著者は,ハイリー・ポッター,ザ・インターセプト・ブラジル,マヌエラ・アンドレオニ,ブラッキー・ミグリオッシ,パブロ・ロブレス,ヴィクトル・モリアマとデニス・ル,All for The New York Times,およびジョセフ・ポリシュク,マリア・アントニエタ・セゴヴィア,マリア・ド・ロス・アンジェレス・ラミレス, from Armando Info/El Pais. プロジェクトは,ピューリッツァーセンターの Rainforest Investigations Network編集部:環境調査編集部: Gustavo Faleiros,執行編集部: Marina Waker Guevara,データ編集部: Kuek Ser Kuang Keng, Reseach編集部: Jelter Meers. この協力の産物である - 1 マルチメディア (前ページ) 記事ブラジルにおけるエアストリップについて The New York Times に掲載 - "Corredor Furtivo" と呼ばれる6つの記事のシリーズマルチメディア要素を同時にEl País と Armando Info に掲載 - 1 インターセプトブラジルでの国際空港とブラジルにおける違法武装集団の関係について 1 ドキュメンタリー発表違法な逃亡者によるパイロットたちの生活と仕事について設立以来,調査は,他のジャーナリストや市民社会関係者にとって,アマゾンにおける犯罪活動を調査する模様として役立つ強力な物語と groundbreaking data analysisを生成する野心を持ちました. 前の報告から,ポッター,ポリスク,ラミレズ,アンドレオニは,規制のない着陸地点は金鉱やその他の違法活動を促進する犯罪インフラに鍵であることを知っていましたが,これまで誰も金鉱と飛行道を体系的に調査し,識別し,地図化することができなかったのです. Rainforest Investigations Fellowsのメンバーは,先端データ分析と技術を伝統的なシュー・レザーレポートと組み合わせ,問題の真の範囲を初めて明らかにすることにしました. チームはEarthrise Mediaと提携して,プロジェクトを支える機械学習アルゴリズムと公共データベースを構築しました. 計算結果を補完し検証するために記者たちは広範なフィールドレポートを行い多くの安全対策を講じました違法採掘の影響を受けた人々と鉱山から運ぶパイロットと話し合いました違法採掘サプライチェーンの異なる部分を訪れました掘削場から秘密の金屋まで分析の異なる部分にはマシン学習アルゴリズムを改善し結果を確認するための手動作業が含まれましたコンピュータプログラムによる衛星画像の並列化は,コーディング問題や技術的遅延を引き起こした.アルゴリズムの開発は,歴史的な衛星画像から情報を手動で選択し,このベースラインをプログラムに利用して最近の画像で類似のパターンを発見した.この機械学習プロセスにより,チームは2016年に遡る数千の高画質のセンチネル2衛星画像をスキャンし,アマゾンで巨大な領域をカバーした. このような統計学および計算モデルは人工神経ネットワークとして知られています. それは44×44メートル10ピクセルの大きさ,地面上 440×440mの相当のパッチを見学するために訓練されました. AIプログラムはブラジルアマゾンで約1269のエアストリップとベネズエラアマゾンで47のエアストリップを発見しました.

2023-f-0007.summary: 1- [Com que programa eleitoral sairia para jantar?] Com recurso a NLP (mas também muito trabalho manual) converti os programas eleitorais dos partidos portugueses numa matriz de concordância e discordância para produzir um “tinder clone” que permitia aos leitores conhecer um pouco melhor as propostas dos partidos. 2 - [Prometómetro] Seleccionamos 150 medidas emblemáticas e relevantes do programa do terceiro executivo liderado por António Costa e, numa base mensal, vamos verificando o estado de cada uma dessas promessas. Fui autor da “news application”, tendo sido responsável pelo seu design, funcionalidades e implementação. 3 - [Travão ao alojamento local pode afectar quase 60% do mercado em Portugal] Fui responsável pela recolha, via “web scraping”, dos dados do Registo Nacional de Turismo e consequente análise para perceber o possível impacto que um travão ao alojamento local teria no país. 4- [Profissionais de saúde já fizeram 9,9 milhões de horas extras no primeiro semestre deste ano] Realizei a recolha e análise dos dados a partir do portal da transparência do SNS. 5 - [Simulador: com a Euribor a subir, faça as contas à subida da prestação da casa] Escrevi o script de R que, todos os dias, recolhe os dados através de uma GitHub Action. Fui também responsável pelo desenvolvimento da news application e das visualizações de dados. 6 - [Conheça o impacto da inflação no seu carrinho de compras] Fui responsável pelo desenvolvimento desta página que todas as semanas mostra como tem evoluído o preço de um cabaz de alimentos 7 - [Quanto mais estou a pagar por combustíveis? Onde estão os postos mais baratos?] Escrevi o script que recolhe e analisa os preços dos combustíveis em Portugal. A news application, também da minha autoria, permite ao leitor estimar quanto é que o aumento no custo dos combustíveis lhe está a custar, mas também ver como variam os preços onde vive. 8 - [Braga é o distrito onde a diferença entre alunos mais pobres e os outros é menor] Analisei a base de dados das notas internas dos alunos das escolas públicas em Portugal. Fui autor da peça, tendo também produzido o scroller, a visualização de dados e feito o desenvolvimento web. 9 - [1926-1974-2022. Como evoluiu o país da ditadura à democracia] Peça que recorre ao scrollytelling para mostrar como Portugal mudou nos últimos 100 anos. Fui co-autor da peça, tendo ajudado a pensar a narrativa e a recolher os dados. Sou autor do código e das visualizações de dados 10 - [Somos 8 mil milhões] Participei no processo de design e concepção da narrativa personalizada, tendo sido o web developer do projecto.
2023-f-0007.summaryJa: 1 [どの選挙プログラムで夕食に出る?] NLP (でも手作業もたくさん) を使ってポルトガル政党の選挙プログラムを合意と不一致のマトリックスに変換して <unk>tinder clone<unk>を制作しました 2 - [プロメメーター] 我々はアントニオ・コスタが率いる第三の行政のプログラムから 150の重要な象徴的な措置を選んでおり,毎月それぞれの約束の現状をチェックしています私は <unk>newsアプリケーションの著者であり,その設計,機能,実装の責任者でした 3 - [地元宿泊業の障害はポルトガルの市場の約60%に影響を与える] 私は,国家観光記録のデータをウェブスクラッピングを通じて収集し,その後の分析を担当し,地元の宿泊業の障害が国に与える影響を認識しました. 5 - [シミュレーター:エウリバーが上がっているので住宅ローン増額を計算してください] 私はRのスクリプトを書きました毎日 GitHub アクションでデータを収集しますまたニュースのアプリとデータビューの開発にも負責していました 6 - [インフレが購物車に与える影響を知れ] 私はこのページの作成を担当しました毎週食料品の価格がどのように変化したか示しています 7 - [燃料に多額の支払いをしているのですか? 最も安価な職位はどこにあるのですか?] 私はポルトガルの燃料価格を収集し分析するスクリプトを書きました私の記事でもあるニューズアプリは読者に燃料コストがどれだけ高まっているかを推測できるし,また,自分が住んでいる場所の価格がどのように変化しているかを見ることができる. 8 - [貧乏な生徒と他の生徒の差が小さい地区であるブラガ] 私はポルトガルの公立学校の生徒の内部の成績のデータベースを分析しました. 私はこの作品の作者であり,スクロールラーも制作し,データ閲覧も行いました. 9 - [1926-1974-2022年] 図書に描いて下さいポルトガルは過去100年間でどのように変化したか作品の共同著者であり,物語を考えるのに協力し,データを収集しましたコードとデータ表示の著者です 10 - [私たちは800億人] パーソナライズされた物語のデザインとデザインプロセスに参加し,プロジェクトのWeb開発者でした

2023-f-0008.summary: Our “Cities and Climate Crisis” series consists of four infographics. 1.Rising seas threaten world’s airports (available in English) According to a Nikkei analysis of 5,014 airports around the world, 753 (15%) are located less than 10 meters above sea level. The UN Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) predicts that sea levels will rise by 1 meter by 2100 under a scenario in which greenhouse gas emissions remain high. We used this estimate to conduct a simulation that found 35 airports would be below the sea level if it rose by one meter. 2.‘Zero-meter zones’ expand globally as sea levels rise (available in English) This project analyzed the impact of sea level rises on coastal cities in various regions, including Tokyo, Japan. The map shows the affected areas according to the degree of sea level rise. We also highlighted the flood control and evacuation measures envisioned for each area. 3.Heat Island: increased risk of heat stroke (Japanese only) In this project, we addressed the “heat island” phenomenon in Japan: that temperatures are higher in urban areas than elsewhere. The work looked at the impact of temperature rises in major cities, focusing on numbers of heat stroke victims in Tokyo, Osaka, and Nagoya. 4.Threat of megastorms (available in English) With the help of university researchers, we studied the increase of “bomb cyclones”: sudden drops in atmospheric pressure. We used data from the Japan Meteorological Agency to portray rapidly developing bomb cyclones in a three-dimensional time series. The project used recent trends in typhoon paths to show the increase in precipitation associated with the extreme weather. Social media users responded very positively to the work and its innovative design. In November 2022, we won a Japan Typography Annual award from the Japan Typography Association.
